We loved this apartment and didn't want to leave! We could walk to everything and were right in the middle of everything but it was so quiet and peaceful.  We can't wait to return.  Note: If you have children, the apartment is on the 2nd floor and the steps are quite steep.

The apartment 100% corresponds to the photos, sunny and cozy, not so far from the city center (40 minutes by walk). The owner helped me with all the questions I had and responded very quickly. I would highly recommend this place to stay.

Fabulous apartment. Almost new and extremely clean. Excellent beds, bathrooms, kitchen etc. Pedro was excellent. Two little points, don't leave a glass of water beside your bed because it will probably fall off! Heating is a little difficult to control. I would definitely return.
Brilliant spot in Porto, close to the river and vibey restaurants. The place was beautifully done, with everything you could ever need. Highly recommend!
Amazing place to stay, great apartment, location, would definitely come back. Might not be adequate for young kids due to the stairs.

This apartment was fantastic- everything was clean and comfortable, and the cool layout of the place makes it seem very roomy. And Pedro was an absolutely wonderful host- he was easy to reach, incredibly thoughtful, and lovely to meet! We would definitely stay there again and recommend it highly to friends.

André is awesome. He is really a great host. He was very welcoming and also available for questions and suggestions. We had our private room and bathroom there. I don't know about the public transport except that the bus stop is nearby and the bus that stops there takes you to the centre (30min). I really recommend the place if you love dogs as I do 💖
Beautiful palce to stay! Miguel was a very friendly host and shared some great recommendations for Porto. Thanks for hosting us!
The Airbnb was perfect, very clean and complete. We really loved the location, very close to the shops and restaurant. We definitely recommend this to everyone!
Nice, little, clean and cosy appartment with a well equipped kitchen. No noise from the street or from the other appartments in the building.

Ana was incredible. We were welcomed into the flat with some port wine and one of the best chocolate cakes that I have ever eaten.  Ana and her husband provided us with great information about what to do in Porto with our 4 year old. The apartment had a great location and was in great condition.

Ana was very accommodating during our stay by giving us a list of restaurants to visit in the area as well as things to do! She even baked us a chocolate cake which was very delicious :) The place was also very well located with an easy walk down to the historic centre as well as many public transport stops around the area. Can’t wait to come back!!
A great apartment that is far enough outside the city center to be away from the mobs of tourists, but close enough to be walkable.

We had a great stay in Joana’s apartment. Even though we arrived late due to lost luggage she stayed up late and gave us a great welcome and introduction and recommendations of the city. The apartment was also very nice and tidy, and just a short walk from the beach. Couldn’t have asked for more!

Everything went very well. Very friendly and quick communication with the host. The apartment was exactly as described. We can highly recommend the location of the apartment, with a sea view and close to the beach and the charming neighborhood streets in Foz, as everything is easily accessible from there.
Such an amazing stay and check in was so easy! Claudia was great and the apartment was in a great location!

Fantastic stay in a beautiful house. Its a huge house with lots of spaces for relaxing and privacy. The house is exceptionally clean and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The bikes were a extra bonus.
One of the best air bnb we have stayed in. Modern apartment with all the necessities we needed for our stay. Highly recommend

We had an amazing stay in spite of the rainy weather. Porto has so much to offer and everything is within walking distance. We rented a car and drove from Lisbon but we later realized that a car is not needed. There is great transportation to get you around. We definitely recommend this place as it is very centrally located.
A really great location! Easy to walk to everything we wanted to do. The balcony was amazing to relax on after a long day!
It was quiet place, clean and secure. Not noisy, l liked the parking in the basement, the AC was good.

We stayed at Vasco's flat for 3 days and it was an excellent base for touring PORTO. The flat was immaculately clean,  nice touches on arrival and a very good responsive host. Communication was excellent,  great WiFi connection also.

This place is amazing!! So cute, so neatly and a perfect location! Cristina helped us more then we could ask for. With lots of information and even tried to help us book a massage and pedicure. Many thanks we will definitely come back!

Very lovely stay at Cristina’s place, our 6 year old daughter slept very well on the sofa bed despite the pouring rain! Kitchen easy to use and fully equipped. Very private & quiet. A few minutes walk to bus & tram so quickly in the city center or at the beach side.

Absolutely comfortable, stylish, and thoughtfully designed apartment — every detail has been considered. I stayed here during a workation and spent a lot of time at home, so I truly appreciated how well-equipped and cozy the space was. Cristina is incredibly kind, responsive, and always quick to answer any questions. The apartment is just a 3-minute walk from the Douro River and 5 minutes from the ocean. You’ll find parks, stylish cafés, and restaurants of all kinds nearby. The city center is about 15 minutes away by taxi.

This is a lovely quieter corner of Porto to stay in, a bit more lowkey but easy to get into town (we love to walk everywhere), or catch the metro which is ~10 mins walk. The building/accommodation seems quite new, and the courtyard was not accessible yet, which was a shame because we had seen some photos and were really excited! Check in relies on someone meeting you there, and given you cannot always be sure of your arrival time this can be a bit tricky/stressful, but the team were really responsive and it worked out.  All in all it was a little less homely / artisinal than we maybe expected but comfortable, clean, modern and we had a great stay.

Well equipped apartment. It is well located in a nice neighborhood with restaurant and close to city center.  All communications done with a renting agency and not directly with the owner of the apartment, be prepared to receive several messages per day for all types of communication related to the appartement (arrival, stay, visits, departure).

Amazing stay and host. The apartment is centric and you can walk anywhere from there. The apartment was cozy, clean and beautiful and the host was very responsive. If we come back, we would definitely chose this airbnb again.
This was my favorite place that I stayed in Portugual. Very spacious and the location was excellently. Everything was super clean. Would definitely return
Lovely clean apartment with all amenities you could need. Great location with easy access to main tourist spots, yet nice and quiet at night.  Very easy check in and check out process.

Wonderful accommodation! It was extremely clean, and everything felt new and fresh. The hosts even left a bottle of welcome wine, which was such a lovely touch. We were also able to check in early, which made our stay even more convenient. The location was perfect, just a few minutes’ walk to the city center. Highly recommend!

Everything about the place is great, clean, easy to use and exactly as described. It’s a fantastic location with close walking distance to the old town and surrounding restaurants and sights. Thanks Alexandre for a great stay!

This airbnb made the holiday in Porto even better. The hosts are very welcoming and ready to help at any request. The location is very central and the flat has everything you need and it’s just like you see it in the pictures: beautiful, modern and clean. If you’re staying in Porto, I would definitely recommend you book this airbnb.

We had a great time here. The apartment was spacious and modern design with beautiful furniture. The neighbourhood is lively and cool. There're so many nice restaurants and bars around there. We wish we could stay longer here.

Don’t look further!  Best airBnB we’ve ever stayed in, by a mile!  Beautiful place, tastefully furnished, clean, and everything we needed and more. Location is perfect as well, we easily walked every where, and there are lots of lovely restaurants and terraces very near by.  The 5* is well-deserved.  We absolutely loved the food, drinks and people at Coupage 51, just around the corner.

I really liked the apartment, location and condition of the apartment. Clean, cozy, has everything you need, luxurious location. What else do you need for a good vacation?)) Nice attentive owner of the apartment, quick answers to questions. The overall impression is wonderful, I want to come back more than once to this wonderful city! Thank you, Alex!
Easy to find, central location. The space is beautiful! We really appreciated all the extra amenities in the kitchen- made cooking our own meals super easy. Would definitely recommend this place!
Great location and enjoyed the rooftop view! Easy to walk down to the promenade. Easy to check in and Filipe was a very kind and responsive host. Highly recommend.

The location is very central, walking distance to the ribiera, cathedral , restaurants and other local attractions. The building is clean and very well maintained (or newly renovated ?). The appartment is as shown on pictures, very clean and has everything inside (Shampoo, shower gel..  Convenient for backpack travellers 😊). Filipe is very available to respond to any questions. Thanks !! We had a very great stay !!
We enjoyed our stay in Porto- this place has an excellent location and is very clean and comfortable.
exactly like the pictures!! super modern and clean. Filipe was very helpful answering my questions. The beds were comfortable. perfect location. easily walk everywhere

The apartment is beautiful and  located perfectly in walking distance to shops and restaurants. The streets in front of the apartment can get very noisy even in the middle of the night but the bed is hidden away behind thick glass doors which help a lot and make it possible to sleep.
Location was perfect; right at the centre of everything! We walked everywhere.  Pictures of the place are accurate so expect the same! Clean and cozy space!

Daniel was very nice, responsive. And helpful with suggestions for restaurants and parking. We loved our stay in Porto! Location was superb! We could not have asked for a better location. Felt very fortunate to find this place!

this place is special. centrally located, but the moment you walk in feel completely removed from the noise of the city. impeccably decorated in good taste, the backyard/garden feels like a slice of paradise, and the bedroom (with central AC that actually works!) is both beautiful and perfect for sleep.  highly recommended.
This was one of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed at. Ricardo couldn’t do more for us, from early check in to mid stay cleaning. Lots of room for our group. Highly recommend.

Our stay at Ricardo’s apartment in Porto was wonderful! This is a prime location, beautiful apartment, and walking distance to everything. Perfect for large families or groups looking to take in the best of what Porto has to offer!
Lovely, secure place to relax after a day of exploring. Easy access to great restaurants and bars.

We had a fantastic stay at Isabel and Igor’s apartment in Porto. The place is beautiful, better than the pictures. Location is great, you can walk to all the important landmarks. And Isabel was available at all time which made our stay so much easier. We look back to being in Porto again and would definitely stay here again

fantastic stay at this Airbnb. It exceeded our expectations as I dont think the photos do it justice. We were blown away by the gorgeous architecture of the building and design of the apartment. Very spacious for our weekend getaway. The balcony overlooked a quiet market and location was spot on to visit the river, old town and walk all around to explore wonderful Porto. Highly recommend.

Excellent property in a prime location.  Easy access to all major sites within walking distance, and a very convenient parking lot right next door.  We have stayed in several different apartments in Porto, but this one felt like a much more authentic experience and not a cookie cutter remodel like many other listings.   Highly recommend this stay for anyone visiting Porto.

It’s ok. It’s central and convenient. The apartment is big, and holds a family quite comfortably. The living room decoration is nice. 2 rooms are on the smaller side, but it makes sense as this option enable the house to have one more bedroom. The general feeling of the apartment refurbishment is that it could have more quality, especially taking into consideration the asking price for a night. There are definitely some sub par material and building quality options (I’m not referring to the old/historic nature of the apartment, but specifically to the new fittings. If you can live with that for a few nights, it’s an ok place.
Excellent home in a great area of Porto.  Clean, modern and very comfortable.  Alexandra was a great host.

What a fabulous stay!  Alexandra helped arrange transportation from the airport from a super nice driver and Mario helped us get oriented, gave us lots of great recommendations and was super helpful.  The apartment is modern but still warm because of the great decorating and the location is great too.  Great stay. Hope some day we’ll be back.

Alexandra’s place was pristinely clean and matched the photos. A perfect spot for 6 guests to live comfortably. Enjoyed the views from the kitchen and the furniture was comfortable. Alexandra was also a very attentive and responsive host. Would recommend to anyone visiting Porto!
We enjoyed our short stay in Porto! This place was very comfortable and we loved the views. We liked being close to restaurants, shops and historic sites. Thank you for sharing your home with us!

a nice place. what was not apparent is that it's one studio in a house with several other studios and a common area. we still had privacy in the unit, but it did not feel like a separate place but rather a set of larger remodelled rooms that were all Airbnb rentals.
Great location, maybe the best in Porto. Flat is really cute, new and perfect for a couple. However the entire house and the flat has a smell from the sewage pipes coming and going.
Great little self contained apartment in a fantastic location. Has everything you need for a short stay. Would happily recommend.

Good place for the price you pay, organised, clean and easy to self check in.  Walkable distance to the centrum of Porto with many bakeries, shops and supermarkets in the surroundings. The communication with the host was also smooth. Very much recommended.
I liked my stay at Andre’s place very much and can only recommend it to everyone. Andre himself is a very nice host. I just arrived in Porto and he was very helpful with any problems etc I had.
Had a great stay & would definitely stay here again! The apartment was clean, close to the area I needed to be & they gave me lots of useful information before I arrived. Thank.
Great experience with great, communicative hosts. Check in was in person and professional. Host was availible all the time via phone :) Great metro connection. Wheelchair was not a problem at all :)

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The communication before arrival was very helpful and clear. A bonus was meeting Neo at the building and being guided to the parking and the apartment. The parking garage is tight as are all in Europe, but easy to access and full in and out privileges The apartment is as it looks on the site and has many fun decorative touches. It’s a very comfortable and warm place with very good amenities and a nice outdoor deck.  The location is great. Almost anything you might want to go to is within walking distance and we did that a lot. Remember though that Porto is literally built on the side of a hill and any walk means many changes in elevation including some very steep ones.  We would without a doubt stay here again if we returned to Porto and unhesitatingly recommend it to any couple that wants a comfortable, clean and well located place to stay.
We had a great stay in Porto and it was in a great location. It was good having a car park. We would recommend staying in this apartment.
this place was very cute and greatly located. we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. the garage was convenient and we went able to park and not worry about anything

This Porto studio was a gem! The view was absolutely incredible. The location was perfect, allowing easy access to all the main attractions and great restaurants. Our host was very nice, always responsive and helpful with local recommendations. The studio itself was comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto!
Well located, beautifully appointed apartment, full of amenities, right near the old town. We loved our stay here.

Lovely little spot for a short stay in Porto. Host was very communicative and helpful. Place was clean and tidy. In a great location being close to centre but just within residential zone so nice and quiet. Overall a good stay.

Joaquim was a very communicative host, and the apartment was very well located in Gaia. Everything in the apartment worked and it was very clean and well maintained. The only note would be that if you are three or four people you may run out of hot water as the shower did go cold a few times for us. There were also quite minimal provisions provided in terms of cleaning supplies such as dish soap, toilet roll, laundry liquid, dishwasher tablets, tea towel etc and so if staying more than a few days you will have to buy most of these things. Nevertheless, we really enjoyed our stay at Joaquim’s place in Vila Nova de Gaia and would highly recommend!

A great place, though noisy throughout the night as its on a busy road from down town. it would have been good to have a couple of absorbent cloths and some cleaning spray in the kitchen, but otherwise a great place.
Great place with very cozy apartment. We went to beach several times which only few minutes walk. Very quiet neighborhood and we love to come back again.

Claudio’s place was nice and clean.  Comfortable bed.  Very responsive to are need.  Really appreciated of all the food like snacks, water, milk, coffee and tea we had once we arrived.  That was very much appreciated.  Diane

The Airbnb is amazing, even better than the pictures ! The small garden is really cute and nice to enjoy the sun. The location is great but a little far from the center (which is not bad because de neighboor is very calm). Everything was convenient and clean. I totally recommend !

We had a wonderful stay at Alexandra’s apartment!  She was the perfect host and her place was just what we were hoping for.  Great location in a quiet neighborhood and close to all major attractions in Porto.  The apartment is thoroughly updated and super clean.  We loved our stay and hope to come back soon!
Great host, with a great place. You can walk to all the tourist spots and food within 30 min. The location made the stay very comfortable.

The place was amazing. The apartment was very easy to find, it was clean and there were many restaurants nearby. They also gave us a wine as a gift which made our stay even more perfect.  Overall, definitely worth staying at! :)

This place was very good. It provided anything you could need, in a good neighborhood, walkable from the center of the city. There was a problem with the windows, theere was a lot of noise coming from the street and cold. Also the bathroom door didn't close very wall, so there was a privacy issue there.

Nuno and his wife are SO friendly! It's a great location, next to the beautiful Parque Serralves. It's  walkable with easy access to restaurants and bus stops. I felt quite at home during my whole stay!
Very nice place. With garage. Really convenient if you have a car. Beautiful apartment. Calm area, with really great view.
It was a great stay at the residence. The residence was really cool, nice, peaceful and it met my expectation. Luis is really kind, supportive, proactive and highly responsive.

Very comfortable, quiet, and clean space. It's small, but very cozy, modern, and the view from the balcony is great. There's tons of great restaurants and grocery stores nearby within a short walk. If you like coffee, visit Fabrica coffee which is an easy walk away. The surroundings are much quieter than further towards the river, but it's still very easy to walk down and cheap to Uber back up. Overall, highly recommend this place.

Tons of room in the flat in the middle of Porto. The city market is literally across the street and you are one block from the metro station. Porto is an amazing city as well and it's all at your doorstep.
Overall it was a great stay. We were 8people total and this place accommodated perfectly.
Best airbnb ever. it was WOW. Delicious decour, HUGE apartment, banging location, we all LOVED it.  Thank you, Orla x

My family of 4 LOVED our stay in Porto at this wonderful apartment.  The location was absolutely perfect and walkable to all that we wanted to do in Porto.  It was lovely that there was coffee and wine left for us to enjoy and having the available amenities (shampoo/conditioner) in the bathroom was a very nice touch as well.  I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto!

I had a lovely stay at Francisco's place! It had everything I needed for my one night in Porto. And, Francisco & his co-host were super responsive and helpful. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a nice, comfortable stay in Porto!!!
All ok, only the neighbors had a loud party next to us and the apartment is quite noisy.
great place and walking distance to a lot of resteraunts. only complaint is, you can hear everything inside and outside. walls are very thin and neighbors are very loud.
Maria is excellent host. fast response.  location is excellent.  peaceful and close to metro station and a lot bakeries and restaurants nearby. also supermarket is closely.

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The only thing that bothered us was the limited kitchen equipment. For example, there was only one cutting knife (which was a bit dull), and we couldn’t find a cutting board.  Nevertheless, we had a good night in the Airbnb and really enjoyed our time in Porto.

"Maria Angela was such a wonderful host! She always responded quickly to our questions and made us feel very welcome. The place itself is super accessible, spotless, and very safe. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily come back!"

Excellent host(s)! Very kind and extremely accommodating (I changed my check in several times, thanks again!). The apartment is comfortable, cosy in a convenient yet quiet neighborhood. On that note, Gonçalo recomrecommended a local authentic Portuguese restaurant, "Aliença", it was perfect!

We really liked our stay ! Cute garden and very friendly host . I would recommend this place to anyone who is visiting Portugal but wants to have more of an authentic not so touristy experience . They are many great cofee places and shops near by.

This place is very nice, very large, and very well located.  As advertised, parking would work for a smaller car but our rental was too large -- there is a paid lot across the street that worked for us.  Really can't recommend this place highly enough!

Fantastic Villa, very spacious (we were a group of 6) and modern, with very good outside space and pool. Good location, close to restaurants and beach and transport links to other places. Host was excellent, friendly, helpful and accommodating. We would recommend and stay here again.
Apartment was absolutely gorgeous!! The decor and furnishings were beautiful.  Easy to find.  30 minute walk to the main part.
Great value for Money. Super friendly Host that rund the Show Shop downstairs. Lovely Sunny courtyard with a big cat Family.

Thank you Ilan, Ana and Joao, Your lovely home was the perfect respite after walking the Camino. We love the location to places of interest, shopping, dining and of course, an easy walk to the river. We will definitely recommend your home to others that are planning a trip to Port! Cheers, Mary Petrie
Everything was amazing the airbnb was a perfect location! Very easy to walk around. The apartment was very clean and felt super nice. Would definitely recommend this airbnb!! Thank you!
Beautiful, very clean minimalist apartment with all the required amenities , great location, responsive and friendly host. I would stay here again when next I visit Porto.

If I could give this place and this host more than 5 stars I would. The apartment was not only beautiful, but in a great location which was very walkable and easy to get to via taxi/uber. The host even took time to welcome us and provide a map of the city and his favorite locations which were perfect for our stay. We absolutely loved it!

Fernando’s place is in a great location. We were able to walk most places. We only got an Uber or Bolt if we were going somewhere that had a lot of hills on the way. Fernando was helpful and proactive during communication. I would highly recommend staying at this place when in Porto.

The place is really great, 100% matched the photos. Check in and check out were easy thanks to clear instructions of the host. The apartment has everything you need for short and medium term stay, tastefully furnished, has a big balcony and all the amenities listed. The host was friendly giving immediate response whenever needed. We will definitely come back! Thank you for arranging an unforgettable stay!
Cozy and clean flat, plus you get one time free complimentary cleaning service, which was really nice. The place felt also safe and communication was great.
Had a really great time here. The accommodation has all the amenities one might need, and the weekly cleaning service was a pleasant surprise. I'd love to stay here again someday!
Very confortable staying. Lucia was extremely kind in any moment! I had a wonderfull time in oporto

The accomodation is near the city centre and direct metro line to the airport. Comfortable bed with very sparkling white bed linens. Both the room and ensuite bathroom were very clean. I didn't use the kitchen, but it was available. I did arrive late at night, but self check-in was very easy. It takes 5 mins to get to the city centre using Uber which is not expensive in Porto. Next to the house there is a little cafe to get morning coffee. Overall I do recommend.

One of the best places we´ve stayed so far! The location is top, few minutes on foot from Carolina Michaelis metro station and not so far from the city center. The apartment is brand new and the kitchen is fully equipped for those who want to make some meals at home. Excellent for 3 persons, big and confortable 2 beds and 1 sofa-bed. Everything was clean and organised. The apartment is warm and modern. Try the healthy meals in the LM cafe, in the downstairs, amazing dishes! Luis and Maria are top hosts, they are always there for you and guide you in the places to visit!  You will feel home, we absolutely recommend!
We had a great stay at Hosty’s place. Very clean and tidy apartment with everything provided. Would definitely recommend!

Warm welcome and very responsive host (before and during the stay)! Newly refurbished flat and furniture, comfortable and clean. Comfortable, firm mattresses in bedroom with blackout shutters for a restful sleep. Easy access to Porto's attractions and amenities while still enjoying quiet surroundings. Would definitely try to stay there again when we next visit Porto!
We had a nice cozy stay there.  We had no problem staying there except for the weather.^^ Thanks for everything.

Teresa was a great host. Right when I booked, she messaged me and asked me for anything we needed. Anytime I had a question regarding the stay, she was responsive within the same day. It helped me to be able to pack accurately and the recommendations on the booklet she provided were helpful as well!

Absolutely loved the place: the room is clean and has everything you might need. Complimentary bottle of water and cookies are a nice touch. 😊It’s easy to get to the sights by public transportation as the metro is about 5 -minute walk and the bus stop is very close. The neighborhood is quiet. Will stay again when in Porto. Highly recommend. 👍🏻
Everything is great, just like it in the photo, it’s clean, bright and quiet. It makes us feel even more relaxed than at home.
Beautiful apartment with an incredible view. Carolina was kind, quick to respond, and very helpful. Would definitely stay here again!
Maria was really helpful with her suggestions,  quick reply and always said yes for our requests. the house is very nice and spotless clean :) definitely will stay again.  thank you so much

The apartment was just as beautiful as the pictures suggested. The location could not be any better. We did not use any form of transport except our feet for the entire duration of our stay. The neighbourhood is lively and there are exceptional restaurants and cool stores just around the corner. The entire experience was very smooth. Would return anytime.
Great stay, perfect apartment, clean and well equipped. True to the description. The host is responsive and professional. Have a good stay!
We had a fantastic time - the location was perfect and the apartment was modern and clean. Couldn't have asked for a better space.
The apartment is exactly like the pictures and has everything you need. The place is close to all attractions within walking distance. Thanks again Elson.

The location was fantastic! Close to everything! I would definitely recommend staying here and I’d love to come back and stay again. Very communicative host and a great value for the price! Two thumbs up.

Great location, 15 minute walk to beach which was enjoyable. Close to cafes and restaurants. (Be mindful on weekends not as much availability as some closed) Easy to reach from the metro which was 6 minutes walk away. We were able to enjoy the jazz festival close by in July. Would recommend the area for families. The beach was great and we were able to do some surfing. Beach towels aren't provided by property.

Manuel was very kind, hospitable and accommodating. Keep in mind Maia is not close to city centre, but I managed to get out by taking a bus and train. I enjoyed my stay and got everything I needed. Space I stayed  had lots of room and a modern TV so that was a huge plus. Thankyou again Manuel! Would definitely come back!

This flat is lovely and ideally situated for exploring Porto. It's conveniently located near coffee shops, supermarkets, and restaurants. Communication with GuestReady was a pleasure; they were quick to respond and resolve any issues. We highly recommend this flat!✨️✨️

co-host Rita was amazing.  She gave us a recommendation for a restaurant that was delicious and on the river.  She also arranged taxi service for us.  If we ever come back to Porto just the two of us we would definitely stay again.  If other people come with us we can't because it only sleeps 2. 😍🌞

Our stay was great! The accommodation was perfect, very clean and comfortable. The location was really good, everything was easily accessible. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay!
Really nice place to stay in Porto. Some issues with the WiFi which was not the fault of the owner. Fast communication.

We stayed 4 days, and the place was cleaned and restock with toiletries on the 3rd day which was great.  We paid $10.00/night for private parking right next to the unit.  Everywhere we went was walkable so no need to buy tram tickets.  Porto has a lot of up and down cobblestone, so it was a good exercise.  We used the recommendations for restaurants through Pedro and Guruwalk guide.  We ate where the locals eat which is better food and less expensive for sure.  We spent 4 days in Lisbon and we used tram tickets there but not too expensive.  Overall, we will stay here again.  Thank you Pedro.

The flat was beautiful, spotless and thoughtfully provisioned with everything we needed for our break, including slippers and cotton pads in the bathroom. Pedro was so helpful and welcoming too. A great host, lovely location near all the sights and gorgeous place to stay.
Good recommendation for this appartment 👍🏻👍🏻. Nice location, near to the famous bridge, good restaurants, riverside. everything was perfect 👍🏻👍🏻

The apartment and Pedro were both fantastic. The apartment was great, everything you need and in a convenient location. Pedro was one of the best hosts we’ve experienced, always responsive and happy to help. We recommend the e-bikes for a cycle down the coast!
Exceptional location, and very nice flat. A good size for Porto, plenty of space and the terrace was a real pleasure to have.

Such a good experience. It was my first time in Portugal/Porto and Isabel&Felipe couldn't have been better hosts.  I was welcomed with warmth, given recommendations about the city, what to do and how to get around. They also gave me a free ride to the airport🥰 The place is worth all of the money. It's exactly as in the pictures and has everything you need. It's peaceful and gives you the feel of a little getaway in the Portuguese heaven.  Location is also close to the bus station and LIDL. I will definitely stay again when I'm back. Thank you for your hospitality Isabel&Felipe and congratulations for giving visitors such a great experience😊

The location of the house is amazing, you just cross the road and you’re on the beach and there’s plenty of space. The water is cold and the waves are strong, but you can always move along the beach and look for better spot to swim. The city is close by car but we also walked along the beach and it took us less than 1 hour with 3 kids. Farol restaurant was ace! The host, Maria, is very responsive and always helpful. The one thing that the description of the house didn’t mention is that your accommodation has certain communal features, like washing machine, BBQ and ironing. You also have to pass through the owner’s garage to access the apartments. Some might find it not fully private and might need to know it before booking. However, we had a great time as a family and we would recommend the property and the host to other visitors.
This was a great stay and within walking distance to all the sights the city has to offer. Very spacious.
The apartment was very clean, spacious & had everything needed for my stay. Quiet location and an excellent night’s sleep throughout. Hosts are extremely responsive & helpful.

The apartment is very central, close to sights, restaurants and cafés. It is very beautifully furnished and we enjoyed our stay there. The WiFi works well and the communication with the host was quite easy.
Perfect location, very clean, easy check-in, great furnishing. A bit expensive but worth it!

Amazing location, easily checked in / checked out, very clean. Its just hard to carry a big luggage to the top floor if you are an alone traveller. I was just thinking it would be great if a small bottle of water could be left somewhere to show hospitality after check in.

I absolutely loved my stay at Hugo’s apartment. He was an amazing host, really quick to respond to messages ahead of arrival and so welcoming. The apartment itself is beautiful and the location is stunning, everywhere you would want to find yourself in Porto is walking distance from the place. Could not recommend more highly, looking forward to my next stay here on my next visit to Porto :)

Felipe’s place is amazing. The location is prime. 5 minutes walk from Ponte Luiz 1 and from there you can access the touristic area of Porto.  The place was sparkling clean, it has all the amenities needed while on vacation and as mentioned before, the location is perfect. We didn’t use our car once. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for privacy at a prime location.

The place was amazing and Filipa and Moises were wonderful hosts  -generous with their time, advice and assistance. Nice wine bar downstairs as well! I'd highly recommend the room - spectacular view and great position to check out Porto.

If you plan on having a great trip in Porto, this is where you should stay! Located next to the beach and the historical center, there are plenty of things to see for days and days. The house is also clean, charming and functional. However the main point is Maria Julieta herself: kind and helpful, she made our travel way easier by giving us a commented map and providing precious information about the city, culture and transports. Hurry up and contact her! The price is exceptional, it's totally worth it.
The place is great with a lot of space. Wifi was really good. Sonia was very attentive and we enjoyed ourselves.
Very confortable and extremely well equipped apartment in a calm district of Porto. Close to good restaurants and the Atlantic sea. We could very well come back.

Great place to stay if you like being close to the beach! City center is approximately 30 minutes by bus, with a bus stop nearby (5min walking). There are lots of small coffee places and grocery stores nearby, and the beach is very close as well! Would definitely recommend.
We had a nice stay in Porto. Place is close to city. Mario responded quickly and helped us when we asked something. Although 1 shower wasn’t working and it was pretty noisy.
We had good time staying in Teresa’s house, everything was great, thank you so much Teresa!

We had wonderful stay at Casa Maya. The accommodation was everything we hoped for and more—beautifully maintained, comfortable, and in such a perfect location. Zac's warm hospitality made us feel right at home and we truly appreciate all the thoughtful touches (recommendations, help, etc.) that made our stay even more special. Casa Maya was the ideal retreat for us. Everything about it was so enjoyable. We hope to return someday and will can definitely recommend Casa Maya to everyone!🙂

Flat is as advertised. Great location in Foz near the beach. Lovely renovated old house, ideal for two couples. Paula and her team are professional, easy to reach (even on the weekend), and flexible regarding check in and check out times. The flat is well-equipped for cooking (a few more basics like oil and spices would have been helpful) and sleeping. We had a great stay. I can definitely recommend.

Great location in Porto, walkable to many attractions but in a less busy area. The kitchen is equipped for basic meals and there is a nice balcony. The blinds in the bedroom are great and keep the room very dark which really helped our baby sleep. Cristina was always responsive and communication was great.

Perfect location. 2 blocks to Duoro River where you can take cruises or eat at the many restaurants. We ate at Pimm's Cafe/diner which is across street from the apartment though, and  it has really good pizza and burgers. Yum. Also walkable to Cathedral, the bridge you cross to the Port Cellars and restaurants. Etc. Plus the apartment itself is very clean, stylish, with a very nice kitchen.

The appartment is AWESOME: modern, clean, full equiped, wifi included. There is a parking just below the flat. Great location in the heart of Oporto, closed to main atractions and a few minutes walk to the river. Carla and her friend Sonia are great hosts, very communicative and helpful during all the stay. Great place, recommendable 100%

I had a great stay in Porto. Eduardo waited for me to arrive at the apartment and showed me the apartment. It is a very spacious , sunny and lovely place. The location is great, walking distance to all the attractions and nice restaurants. Would definately recommend to stay here !
I had the pleasure the stay at Miguel's place with my family. it was a lovely location and had everything we needed. I recommend 😄
Very clean and cosy place right in the center of Arouca which was very useful. We very much enjoyed all the little local treats left by the host.
Great place to stay in Porto. Near the city, walkable, and great spots all around. The stay is private enough too. We'll be back!
Cristinas was a wonderful host and I had a wonderful time at the apartment in Porto. Thank you!
Maria’s apartment was beautiful, clean and in a perfect location. We had a great stay and would recommend.
Perfect for two couples though it was a three bedroom apartment. Cristina met us at the front door as per our communication. She was very helpful with parking and suggestions.

Our stay was great, accommodation was clean and all amenities were good. The kitchens are well equipped and kept tidy. It’s about a 30 minute walk into the centre of the city, and the area is nice and quiet.
The host rui is a niceguy who is willing to share info around the area. It is recommended to stay when visiting porto.
Great little apartment in Porto. We went to Primavera sounds and the apartment was perfect for 3 for that purpose. Thank you!
Very nice and clean apartment, good location. A little noisy at night but would definitely recommend when coming to Porto.

Very stylish spot with a great view of the river. It is true this spot is a bit of a walk from any central “bustling” tourist location, which some may prefer, and there’s also quite a bit of construction going on outside the apartment (but you still have a great view!). The hosts were very communicative and accommodating.
Everything what we needed was there. Clean and nice appartment ideal for a couple. Good and save locality near the city centre.
Amazing place, amenities were great and everything was perfecty clean and as shown in pictures. Would definitly come back amd recommend strongly.

previous review mentioned the place is not well lit. we didn't find it and issue. the windows face an alley but it was plenty of space for the sun. the bathroom was fine too. the tub is a bigger step in and out, move the screen door and you can find better footing, reverse your body out of it using your quad and there's no issue of falls. the bed is on the firmer side
Certainly the best view of Porto! Everything was great, just didn’t give 5 stars because the a/c on the bedroom wasn’t working. Otherwise, I recommend it! Great location

This apartment was centrally located and easy to find. Check in was easy and we were even able to check-in early upon arrival in town. The host was very responsive and even gave some great restaurant recommendations. We had a fabulous trip!
Such a beautiful flat in such a beautiful city. The host was so patient and easy to contact for any and all questions and the location couldn’t be beat!
Fabulous apartment with the best views in the city.  Sunset and vino verde from the balcony is best. I would return.

A stylish, comfortable apartment in the perfect loation for exploring Porto. The check in / check out process was made really easy and the host went above and beyond to help get us and our 9 month old baby to and from the airport. Would highly recommend this place!

A stunning apartment with high end finishes and all the amenities you could require during your stay.  I thoroughly enjoyed my time here.  Main sites are in walkable distance and there is a quiet garden on the first level that is very pretty.  The balcony also features a lovely view of the university. Staff were very responsive and it was nice to have recommendations on the website of what is local to the area.  If I had any feedback is that the hot water tends to run out if you have a longer shower so just keep that in mind if there's two people staying or you have long hair like me!  I would definitely stay here again ☺️

Can’t recommend Nuno’s place enough! Amazing apartment with all essentials covered, and in a great location. We arrived very late and Nuno met us and spent time to make sure we had all of the info we needed to enjoy our stay. I hope we can return again!
This was my first experience with airBnB and i am really happy. Porto is a beautiful place and Tina is an amazing person. Her house il beautiful.i hope the best for her :)
Cozy and nice accommodation. It's placed nearby landmarks so almost of place are walkable. Especially recommend here to 1-2 person or long-term travelers. I'm satisfied with here.
Marcia's place is absolutely lovely! Top location in a stunning city. Too bad we only had two days in Porto.

Thank you so much for hosting us at your wonderful Airbnb in Porto. Everything during our stay was excellent! We made sure to leave everything as we found it. We really appreciate your hospitality and hope to visit again in the future!
Marta’s place is exactly like the pictures. Beautiful apartment in a great location. Flexible and easy check in. Would definitely recommend and would come back again!
Everything was perfect. The location, the accommodation, all of it. I can’t thank Judite enough, we will surely comeback!

Pedro was a great host. I was a pretty mediocre guest and he really made the most fo things! My bus was late getting into porto and I only had the night there. He gave me a bunch of great recommendations and even helped me with my bicycle and bags. When I go back to Porto for more time, I hope he is still doing airbnb because I would absolutely stay at his place again.

Host was very accommodating. I missed my flight and let the host know and they happily arranged to meet my friend who had already arrived to give the keys. The apartment is clean and in a great location and easy access to the subway and only a 6 Euro taxi from the train station. We had a lovely stay.

Loved this place.  Solo traveling and it made me feel super at home and safe.  Loved the bottle of wine and coffee in room.  The windows and porch were perfect.  Great AC.  Had a laundry service that I truly appreciated.  Pedro was also very friendly and helpful.  Would stay here every time if I could!  Thank you Pedro🙏

Nice place to stay.  Good to have 3 bathrooms, however the bathroom from the suite room has a bit of smell.  Convenient to pedestrian street and downtown, since Porto is mostly ramps is advisable to take Uber back to the place after a good night out.

Filipa and Bryan were very friendly and the apartment had everything we could have needed and was in a good location near to the river. They provided a range of great recommendations of places to eat and visit. Would definitely stay here again the next time we visit Porto.

Very clean and nicely decorated with several thoughtful touches like wine and chocolate. It’s about 15 min walk from heart of city which is done well specially going down. The old building is well kept and has a lot of character with hardwood floors and high ceilings. The sofa bed was firm and comfortable.  I will definitely return.

The place is great - great location very close to the centre, but still quiet! Simona, the girl who helped us check in was really helpful and nice! She helped us a lot and even gave us advice for good beaches!

The place is great! Just like in photos, bigger than expected and the terrace... oh the terrace! One of the best views in town but less windy than others. I usually prefer to dine out but in this trip I had all the breakfasts and dinners there. Great check-in and check-out experience. We arrived way later than expected and Alex was v fexible! Google maps does take you to the right place, fear not. Would def go back

Absolutely loved the stay! Incredible attention to detail which made it feel very special. Very kind to provide a bottle of wine. The place had everything we needed. The hosts were great,  very responsive and friendly and the folder had loads of recommendations.

I stayed in barbara and Vitor's house one night before walking to Esposende, and everything was perfect. Clean house, nice hosts, perfect location near the beach and the Camino da Costa. Ideal place !
Great flat in a great location. We stayed as Corona was just kicking off and the city and its people couldn't have been more accommodating.
The apartment was great, really liked it. Great location, clean and very responsive.  When we go to Porto again, I would definitely stay again.

I was very impressed with the location and the overall accomodation. the price is comparable to 4 star hotels in the area while the comfort is 5 stars.  the only issue was the laundry detergent is not provided even though they said it will. however you can buy across the street for 5 Euro. I left the rest for the next guest and I hope they enjoy it more than we did!
The apartment is lovely and in a good location - easy to walk everywhere and near a metro if you need. Rui was a great host and was really helpful with recommendations etc :)

Ana’s place is just like the pictures, high ceilings which is a must when the temperature rises. It was very clean and has everything you need (++ for the coffee machine). You have everything nearby including good pastelaria to get your pasteis de nata in the morning. Mateus was a really responsive host and it was a very easy checkin and checkout. Would highly recommend this place for your stay in Porto!

The space is small and cozy - perfect for someone who used it to work and sleep, but otherwise spent most of the time outside. The location is nice and the apartment is pretty quiet (though I am a heavy sleeper). The team is very communicative, and was able to accommodate an early check-in last minute despite scheduling dictating otherwise. Shampoo and conditioner were missing upon check-in, but I brought my own so didn't reach out to them about this. They also left me enough Nespresso pods for a daily coffee and a selection of tea. I had a great time at this apartment.
Beautiful appartment in a great location, check in was quick ans easy and hosts available for help during your stay
Stylish place! Only problem is it lacks windows but the owner supplied it with fans so it was fine :))

We came to Porto for the first time with a group of 6. Teresa was very accommodating and responsive. The house was in a good location and walking distance to everything. The house was also very clean, and spacious for a big group like ours. Highly recommend!

Every member of our group of 9 and a toddler really liked this apartment, especially that each bedroom had a bathroom. The apartment had a sort of industrial feel in its decor. It was very clean with a nice size common area where we could hang out together. It was well located, not far from a subway and about 20 minutes walking distance to historic sites. It also comes with off-street parking. The property is handled by a management company. While communication was not particularly personal, it was overall very good and responsive. Our group would definitely stay here again.
my  mum  and i we   really  enjoyed  our   10 days  stay- Isabel made  as  feel  very  welcome  ! the  room is new and  clean and the house  is  closed  to the  shops  and restaurant !

Great place to stay during our visit to Porto. We especially liked the enclosed terrace room that was bright and comfortable for work which we took advantage of while we waited for a storm to pass. We found a great restaurant right next to the parking area and across from the cemetery. We would definitely stay here again  on our next visit to Porto.

This a true home away from home, and made our vacation just that much better!  At day’s end, we looked forward to retreating to this spotless apartment that clearly has received love and care by its owner. From its art to its book collection, its spacious bedrooms and beautiful sunroom and terrace, the apartment wants for nothing. Paula is super responsive and exceptionally considerate — even providing personalized walking maps for us! I have stayed in Airbnbs all over the world, and this — by far — was my favorite. Was even better than the description — I didn’t know that was possible. Thank you, Paula, for a wonderful and memorable stay! Can’t wait to come back!
Great value for your money and location. Smooth and helpful check and check out process. Would stay here again!

Thanks so much. The location is perfect. In the middle of Ribiera, the ancient and iconic cultural hub of Porto. The appointment is cosy and spotlessly clean with a really nice atmosphere and the most comfortable bed. Also a powerful and hot shower and good cooking facilities. What’s not to love….Bill and Áine.
great location, nice stylish modern studio apartment, beds comfortable, very responsive host, would be nice to have AC as it was hot in summer and too noisy to open the window

A pleasant few days in Porto. Paula was very helpful and communicated in a timely manner both before and during the trip. The map and advice upon arrival was extremely helpful.  We particularly enjoyed the terrace for a relax after a day seeing the sights or a evening drink.  The apartment is located about 15 minutes from the centre and 30 minutes from the river. However we still walked to all the main sites and there are some metro stops close by.

Celia is a very kind and generous lady, a Superwoman! I got lost, and she managed to find me, and helped me with my car hire issues. She will definitely go above and beyond. Her apartment is very nice, and has everything you will need for a nice stay in Porto. It was just a shame my visit was so short.
Central to everything. However, the place is on top of a commercial. Fantastic for two people, with kids or more than two it feels small.  Looks like in the pictures.

The host was amazing : we had an issue with our hotel and had to reserve this Airbnb last minute at 9pm. They answered really fast and agreed to prepare the Airbnb quickly for us on the same night! We are so grateful.  The Airbnb was perfectly located, we were able to walk to every landmark. The apartment also looks beautiful. AC in every room. Perfect for 6 adults!

Joao and Andreia are truly super hosts. Their kind and warm welcome into their apartment makes you feel as if you just arrived  in your own home.  They are very generous as well and received us with staples such as crackers, juice, sparkling water, fresh fruit and a bottle of Porto.  The apartment is beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. There are tasteful details all throughout the interior and exterior spaces.  You will find a well stocked kitchen with everything you’ll need to have a very pleasant stay.  Communication was excellent and clear.  I highly recommend them as hosts as well as their apartment.  It was a memorable vacation.  Thank you!
Fantastic apartment, very helpful host and a great central location. Thank You very much Abel & Rose
Marcia and Andre were lovely hosts and we had an amazing time in this apartment.  Especially loved the terrace and the central location.
Great location, Joao was very accommodating with his help & understanding. The places was clean. Excellent location!

Marcos place was in the perfect location for us. It was close enough to walk everywhere & the apartment was much bigger than we expected. The balcony windows were our favourite part. Tons of bars & restaurants nearby, & the busier waterfront area is only a 15 minute walk. Beautiful stay would 100% recommend!

Very nice place. Spacious and comfortable with a terrace, which serves well for a morning coffee. We were a group of 7 and it was OK, but if you are singles then the max I would recommend is 5 because there are 2 double beds. The location is also central, close to cafes and restaurants (but a 10-minute walk to Rua de Paris where the night bars are). The host is helpful, speaks very good English, and was easy to communicate with.

Sonia’s home was fantastic. It was the perfect stay for us in Porto. Plenty of room for my husband and I and our 2 kids and parents. Sonia was the ultimate host and we had everything we needed for our stay. Great location and incredibly clean!
The place is very clean, the bed is comfy and the location is great. Rita and Miguel are extremely nice and gave us clear instructions. 100% would stay again
Sonia's place was amazing! Well located, spacy, well renovated, great garden... and sonia was very helpful! Highly recommanded

The place was nice and clean. There was a construction going on right next to the room, making it a bit worrisome whenever I opened the windows for ventilation. There is no conditioner or body wash provided, just shampoo. No slippers as well. I could get to pretty much any place I wanted to go to within 10 or so minutes of walk. So it is good for anyone who gets tired easily or is already tired from the trips prior. The bed was comfy. The kitchen is small. The staff were all really professional and quick to respond.

This is a very clean and spacious apartment in a lovely and charming part of the city. The apartment itself could do with a few personal touches however. Something nice on the bare white walls or some features that reflect the city of Porto.
Amazing stay, very clean and accommodating. The room and the house is very pretty and cool. Would recommend 100%. Also, Joao is very responsive and helpful :) will come back again!

The location was ideal - - - We appreciated the short walk from the train station (no taxi required).  We were able to walk to the busy area where most attractions were; the river was a bit of a walk but we still managed it.  We spent three nights and could have easily stayed for a few more with so much to do in Porto - - - maybe next time.  Our hosts responded quickly to our questions and we would certainly stay there again.

Private balcony area was a beautiful addition to Miguel’s place and the apartment was in an excellent spot that was easily walkable to many of Porto’s beautiful attractions. The quaint touches added charm to the apartment. We were very happy with our time in Miguel’s place.
Great,great,great location.Appartment was very clean .  it is situated in the hearth of the city.Higly recommended

Pedro’s place was immaculate! It was a gorgeous place and Pedro met us at the door and walked us through everything inside the Airbnb. Also left a bottle of wine for us to enjoy! He sent us links with suggestions of where to find groceries, restaurants etc. We used quite a few of those suggestions. I would definitely recommend his place, it was a rare find.

We really enjoyed this place - in a nice quiet part of town, but still walking distance to everything you want to see on the riverfront. Luis met us at the door, and had recommendations on every sort of thing you could want to do that he sent us (tourist attractions, port cellars, different types of restaurants, different shops, etc.), he was very easy to deal with. The place was lovely and I would definitely recommend it! Artwork was very nice too!

This place was amazing! It has  the most magnificent views of Porto and was a great place for our family of 6.  We loved the city and such a convenient location. The host was very accommodating and helpful and extremely kind. Highly recommend!!!
We had a great time in Antonio´s flat which is very well located, brand new, clean. Futhermore, Antonio welcomed us very well and was available for us when we had questions ! Everything was perfect.

Fantastic stay in a centrally located well equipped apartment. The views from the balcony were a bonus!  The communication with Eva and Dani was quick and the self checkin instructions were easy. Highly recommend this place.

The place is great and in a fantastic location.  The house is perfect for 4-5 people and is very clean, has most of the things you need. I’d only call out the fact the checkin was tough, the full instructions weren’t shared in advance and I had to message their helpline number about the entry to the building. The keys are inside and you are dependent on them opening remotely. Once sorted, the place was perfect.  I’d also suggest to have more toilet papers, things to clean etc. the place is in great location,  clean and very cool.
We absolutely loved this place! Renovated, extremely clean, beautiful space and decor, spacious, good location. Great tips from Nathan at check in; we definitely recommend it.

My friends really enjoyed staying at Hugo's place. He was really helpful and welcoming, the appartment is beautiful, comfy and clean just like the pictures, and with everything you may need. We trully recommend this place.

Lovely helpful hosts. Quick to respond. The apartment is clean and well prepared, nice bed linen upstairs. It is a 3rd floor walk up and the internal staircase was a problem to us as it is a very steep, narrow and open spiral staircase. The kitchen is well stocked with china, glass etc and a good size dining table. There is no separate sitting area. This part of Rua Formosa is a little unloved but a few minutes from main shopping street and nice restaurants. Main sites of interest no more than 20 minutes so easy to get around.

This is a really beautiful apartment in the perfect location for a visit to Porto. Everything is easy walking distance. The apartment itself is very new and spotlessly clean and has everything you need.

Location was soooo good. I didn't pay any transportation fee and you can communicate well but Wifi worked slowly 😭 usually I used my data. when I turned on air conditioner, Water leaked out. so I turned off.
Tomas was great to communicate with. Kind and helpful! The location was awesome…totally worth the stair walk!
We were very impressed with the apartment and the service we got from Claudia. Will definitely be back.

The appartement is just like in the photo’s. Awesome! The location is super great! Everything in 15 minutes by feet. Al though I wouldn’t recommend is to people who want to go to bed between 22pm and 2am. Because it vested at a  square where young people get together at night. But me and my to friends loved it there. And I like the background noise to fall a sleep. Also if you like the go out you have a lot of possibilities in the neighborhood (5 min. max). I would go there again without a doubt!
Great location and Hugo was a perfect host. Was waiting at the apartment even though our flight was delayed and gave lots of useful advice.
I had a restful and restorative stay at Pedros. Great location and nice private room for a great price. Pedro was a great communicator as well!
Great location—easy access to many attractions, shopping streets, and restaurants.  Apartment is stylish, perfect for shorter stays. Would stay again!

A great place to stay! A bright, sunny, well-decorated apartment - spotlessly clean, very quiet. (The owners even left us a small complimentary bottle of port, which we thought was nice touch.) Location was perfect - steps to the riverfront area, restaurants, shopping. We arrived by car - we were able to pull up to the door to load/unload bags, and then park in an inexpensive parking lot a short walk away. Definitely recommend.

Great location to visit Porto in the heart of the historical district.  Everything accessible by foot  Well equiped for a family with young kids.  The only dowside its a little bit noisy until 10pm with musicians playing in the streets above.
The apartment was great, clean and in a very Good position. Reccomended! 😁

Apartment was in great location! Walkable distance to all main attractions and old town. Lot of restaurants near by. Apartment was quiet and windows facing to town with nice sunset view. I would stay here again for next stay.
We had a great stay at Manuela's place. There was a garage for our car and the check in and out was very easy.
Sweet Apartment, central location and Alexandra was very helpful. We would recommend Alexandra and her Apartment!
This was a great stay! Would highly recommend! My family and I had a great time staying at this place!
A very clean, compact apartment in a good location. The outside area on the balcony was very pleasant and relaxing.
Carmo’s place is full of cute little decorations, making it feel just like home. It’s easy to access public transportation and is close to a shopping mall and a supermarket

We had a lovely stay at Once Upon A Time. The apartment was a spacious penthouse suite, larger than expected. The outside patio with a view of the square was enjoyable and we loved the location. Will definitely stay here next time we’re in Porto!

Pedro's welcome defined our visit. I've never had a better host. Incredible welcome, guidance and recommendations. All details of the apartment were fantastic. Compact two bed, two bathroom with all required kitchen products and accessories. Aircon included. Optional parking which is valuable in the city. Loved the stay!
Highly recommend! Constantino's place has that special quality that makes a place feel like home. Plus, Constantino was a wonderful host.

Accommodation is perfect in a great location, all places of interest and port are within a 20 minute stroll away. We were met by Pedro, who was lovely to talk to and very informative. I would highly recommend this accommodation.

We stayed here recently for 2 nights whilst exploring Lisbon. It is ideally situated and means the centre is very accessible. Plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment is sparking clean and although small, it is very stylish. Amenities are good and everything I needed was at hand. Air conditioning too. Only  negative is that bed is built up and only accessible from one side so this may not suit everyone. Otherwise perfect.
Claudia is a very friendly host. She gave us some nice recommendations . The appartment is well located. We would recomend this air b&b.

I really enjoyed staying in Claudias Home. It is so beautiful, clean, bright, modern and comfortable. I was feeling at home since the first day and I am so thankful for the opportunity to wash clothes and to use the spices in the kitchen. Also the communication with Claudia and her family was really easy. The only thing that I didn't expect was the noisy cars outside by night. But all in all we are really thankful for the great time im Loft Seixo.

A wonderful unit! Very clean, spacious and nice and bright. We really enjoyed staying here and would highly recommend it. It's about 15-20 minutes walking distance from downtown and its a great walk with restaurants.

The flat is modern, very clean, you have everything you need, small markets right next door. The flat is also well equipped. A 10-15 minute walk to the old town is also super good. The coffee shop across the street is also highly recommended.  However, I found the street really noisy, which I hadn't noticed in the other reviews. But during the day, you are usually out and about all day anyway, so you can get over that.  If you don't have a problem with loud noise, go for it. Because the price-performance ratio is very fair!

A cozy and species apartment with everything you need. Well equipped kitchen, amazing shower and all is clean and new. Super nice hosts!!  They made sure we’re comfortable and satisfied. Zero complains and strongly recommended :)

My boyfriend and I stayed in Marcias sweet Appartement. It is perfectly located for a citytrip in Porto. We arrived by car and get a parkingspace in front of the Appartement. Marcia was very kind and gave us good advices for our stay. Thank you very much.   Bests Julia & Timm
A great Airbnb that let us feel very cozy and part of the community. It’s close to the river, but a little far from the central shops and cafes. Carla is an amazing host. Would recommend!

Our group of 8 had a wonderful stay in Tiago's apartments in Porto. Location was perfect - quick and easy access to stores, markets, restaurants, attractions, riverfront, and Ponte Luis I to walk over to Vila Nova de Gaia. Together, we had both top-floor neighboring units (4 people each). There are no other units on the floor so it was very private. The elevator was a huge bonus. Both units were as advertised, clean, and bright. One unit had a combined washer/dryer and small balcony, and both units had their own separate lockboxes and sets of keys. Access to the apartments was very straightforward - Tiago's directions were clear and he provided videos to facilitate the check in. Everything went smoothly with our stay and we would absolutely stay here again!

The house was in good shape but the outdoors space and the rugs were quite dirty which was a bummer with two toddlers. This is in a very residential area so not much to do in the immediate vicinity. The hosts were helpful and also arranged for a midweek towel and sheet change which was great!
Highly recommend Margarida’s place! It was centrally located, beautiful, and she was very communicative and helpful during my stay :)

I would definitely recommend this beautiful, well decorated, cozy house in an amazing  surrounded environment. Olga is a super host that cares about your comfort and needs. It’s a friend that we love to have when we leave our own house to travel and find ourselves “at home” Thanks for hosting my family  We had a unforgettable journey

This is a great place to stay. Manuel (Ines father) was great during the checkin and explained the apartment and local area very well, which was really useful. The apartment is very central and pretty much all the sights and many restaurants are in walking distance. The apartment was really clean, modern and had all the amenities for our stay. Definitely will rebook if we are back in Porto. Thank you Ines and Manuel.
The property was very well-managed and Pedro was punctual, friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay!

This is a great neighbourhood! The area is walkable with tons of restaurants, bars, and parks. The apartment is spacious and the shared backyard is a bonus if you have a pet. The team is extremely attentive. Thank you!
The flat is very nice and clean. It is centrally located. Eduardo is a very pleasant host.

Beautiful flat in an incredibly convenient location. Right in the middle of Porto and you can easily get to everywhere you could want to on foot. The flat was very comfortable and spotlessly clean, with lots of great touches like coffee machine, Netflix etc. Loved having a meal on the balcony and watching the street below.

The apartment is located in extreme closeness to the public transport, there are a few bakeries nearby. The place itself is absolutely lovely, cosy, clean, light and bright. Constantino is a great host👍 He's polite, attentive, cheerful😊 I will for sure book this flat next time I'm in Porto🧡 Lots of love from Ukraine🇺🇦
We enjoyed our stay in Porto! The apartment was very quiet and away from the bustle of the city, though easy to walk to (or take the subway) to any point in our itinerary.
The location of this place was amazing! Just a few steps away from all the happenings Porto has to offer with great views of the bridge.
Everything was great. The apartments have 2 separate rooms and a common large living room. Pedro is friendly guy. he gave us a lot of advices what to see in Porto.

Everything was wonderful!   The apartment is stunning, and in a fantastic location.  It’s easily accessible to the train station and center of town.  The air conditioning worked perfectly throughout.  The bedrooms are comfortable and quiet. The kitchen also has everything you want.

Lovely spacious apartment. Three of us stayed here for 5 days and had a wonderful time. The flat was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed. It is very centrally located, we walked everywhere from this location! Lovely bars and restaurants close by. Abel and co were easy to get hold of if we needed anything too. Thank you for a great stay!
This is a very peaceful spot. Beautiful garden, short walk to the beach and a great pool. Perfect for a weekend with our toddler. Thanks so much.
Apartment was amazing, fabulous location and very beautiful. Hosts were quick to resopd to respond and lovely. Could not ask for anything more. I would highly recommend.
Thoroughly enjoyed stay and apartment. Wonderful location easily accessible to restaurants and attractions. Pedro was great and kind host.

I stayed at this apartment for a week and I was amazed by the great views of the city and the river. The apartment is clean, and well-equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The host was very friendly and helpful. The location is perfect, as it is close to many attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. I enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and exploring the charming streets and buildings. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to experience the beauty and culture of Porto Lisbon. It was one of the best Airbnb experiences I ever had!

The stay was wonderful, and relaxing as always we have used this apartment many times.  Home me are fantastic any problems they are on it immediately.  The only issue is the dishwasher never has salt or rinse aid, this is the only negative.
I stayed for 5days and it was a very good place. It’s convenient to go to downtown(by walking 15min) and taking a subway. I had a great trip, thanks!
The Home Me experience was as expected very good. Genuinely felt at home and a recommendation you to make thuis your home away from home.

Mouzinho 134 is a really nice, big and well equipped apartment. It's location is great, at walking distance from everything! Eugenia was very nice, she really made everything for us to feel at home, gave us a lot of useful indications about the city and was lovely to our son! Definitely a place to stay in Porto.
The apartment was very comfortable with a gorgeous patio and plenty of space for our group. Location was great too! Thank you for making check in very easy and providing great recommendations!
Flat fully furnished in recently renovated building. Just one remark, there is a restaurant right below, and customers sitting outside might make it a bit noisy.

Well located…Porto is at you doorstep. Finding the flat was very easy if you are arriving at Sao Bento. The flat was extremely easy to check in to and the team supporting the flat were very communicative. There is ample room in this stylish flat. We were travelling with two teenagers and everyone was able to find space.  When we find ourselves in Porto next time, we would certainly stay here again.

The apartment’s location couldn’t be better in visiting Porto. The place was well remodeled, with soundproof windows and kept its original charm (high-ceilings). It was spotlessly clean and had all the amenities for a short stay. The host (Manuela) sent us easy to follow checkin instructions and was always proactive and available.  The apartment is on the 2nd floor and has no elevator - the listing makes it clear, but make sure you know it’s quite an effort if you have any heavy luggage with you.  Finally, and unrelated to the quality of the apartment, don’t bring a car with you (we did…). You won’t need it in Porto, and if you park at the nearby Cardosas parking, it will cost you 36 Euro per night without in/out privileges. Some of the previous guest comments are not right.  Anyway, great place, great host. Highly recommended!!!

Christina’s place is beautifully designed, welcoming and comfortable. It’s well equipped, guest friendly and made us feel right at home. The house is so unique and close to cafes, shops, and the big park along the river. Christina was very responsive and helpful host. Thank you! We look forward to coming back!
Very nice place, just the right size for a couple and a nice location. Very clean and a nice touch with a welcome bottle of wine. We would recommend this place.

This apartment was lovely and clean, it has the most beautiful view of Porto and was located in a great location in Villa Da Gaia. Everything was walkable and it was very comfortable. Would definitely recommend this beautiful apartment.

Patricia’s listing is the ideal place to stay for those wishing to explore Porto. All attractions are within walking distance since you are in the heart of the action (or public transport is only a few steps away). The accommodation was spotless and very cozy. Plus, it includes a balcony from which you can look out upon the action below, and a wine bar on the ground floor. Also, Patricia was very communicative, and checking in/out was a breeze. If I return to vacation to Porto again, this will absolutely be the place I will want to stay.

I’ve travel a lot in Europe and it’s definitely the best Airbnb I’ve ever experienced. The host was so nice and heartwarming. Even gave us the fruits that she planted when we arrived. The appartement is huge, bright, private, clean, comfortable, heartwarming. With a very cute balcony and garden for getting some sun during breakfast. The host even let us put our luggages after we check out, because we left Porto at midnight. If I ever be back to proto, I’ll definitely want to be reserve this Airbnb again ! Absolutely worth more than what we paid for it ❤️‍🔥Highly recommend for everyone 🩵🩵
The place is super central to the main shopping street of Porto and the place was clean and as described! Had a wonderful time.

Florinda and the property were absolutely fantastic.  We were able to store our luggage after arriving in the morning at Florinda’s shop, which is located a few doors away from the flat.  The home itself is very clean, bright and airy, and has the most incredible patio in the back looking across the river to Gaia.  It was perfect for wine in the evening and coffee in the morning.  The flat is also within walking distance to everything you’d want to see in Porto.  We all loved it and would definitely stay here again.  Thanks for everything, Florinda.

A lovely old house that perfectly suited our family holiday. The pool was brilliant for the kids to thrash around in and the outdoor cooking area was great too. It's in a nice area - quiet and not very touristy, but also slightly out-of-the-way. So having the hire car was very useful.
Hi, it was great experience and we would like to come back in future. Thank you for made my trip easy and homely❣️ Regards Roop
Thank you Yves and Ana for early check in. That was big bonus for us Thank you so much

Such a lovely apartment, central to everything, with a terrace right next to this beautiful church. EVERYTHING is walkable. Apartment was very clean. Hosts were so helpful, gave me great recommendations, and even let me keep my luggage in their office while I walked around before the apartment was ready. The only not-so-great part was the four floor, super narrow walk-up. Other than that, the apartments was amazing for a college girls trip!
We would recommend Filipa's place as it overlooks the river and is surrounded by great places to visit and dine.
Really nice apartment! Although we had some problems with our flight and came 3 hours late, we had no problems with our host and thankfully he waited for us! Obrigada!

Great amenities in a clean and fresh remodeled apartment. Great shower and bathroom, has a dishwasher and clothes washer, and everything you need to cook a full meal.
