Tv in the living room AND in the bedroom. Absolutely exceptional host -- probably the best if not one of the best hosts I've ever stayed with. Very informative, knowledgeable, helpful, quick to respond, and friendly. He enjoys hosting and it shows. The apartment being spectacular as well is an added bonus to staying with Joao!

We stayed at the PortoWhite apartment for New Years and it was the best location. Very close to everything in the city, in a nice pedestrian street.  The apartment was clean, spacious and very well furnished. Thoughtful touches all around the apartment.   If I may, it was just a little cold at night but that’s just me being picky.  We totally recommend !
Beautiful place,  overall very satisfied with our stay. Also very similar to the pictures, only problem was with the bathroom door it couldn't close and open easily.
We loved staying in Olga's apartment. It was beautiful and in a great location. We would definitely return!

Loved the apartment!  The location was superb, it was tidy, had a well equipped kitchen, a perfect fit for 2 adult couples traveling together.  Bedrooms were comfortable and allowed for privacy at night. Having the little deck off the living area was a bonus, we enjoyed sipping our wine and/or coffee just enjoying neighborhood.  Elio was super helpful in coordinating a place for us to be able to watch our local football game while we were in Porto and also managed to drop off umbrella’s due to some wet weather during our stay.  As a side note I recommend utilizing the sight seeing on/off bus and boat combo tour, It was great . I give Porto in general and this apartment 5 stars all the way across the board. 🤩  stars across the board from me !
This place has a wonderful shower and is very stylish. It can be quite noisy at night, so bring earplugs. Great location, otherwise. Steps to everything you want to see.
I needed a place to stay near Av. da Boavista for work and the Music Hall - Yellow Submarine was a great option. Will try to book it again in the future.

IT was a Nice and big appartement, clean and every kitchen aplliances were good quality.  The place was well located also.  The husband of Helena welcomed us and explained to us where was the best spots to visite in Porto on a card.  I would recommend this place to everyone.
Everything was perfect and we had a delicious Portuguese champagne on top of it. Could not als for more. We felt so at home. Also, the best area to be in. We loved it.
Nice apartment with great views. Kitchen was fully equipped for cooking. Some nights the street was noisy if you are a light sleeper or sensitive to noise.

This place was in convenient location for shopping and dining. Maria arranged transfer from the airport and was so helpful for us with big luggage. There were some noises from next room or upper room but acceptable. I do recommend!

Teresa's house has personality to sell. On several levels, with glass walls (but good curtains for the night), well renovated, furnished with taste and pragmatism, very clean. It made our stay in Porto a unique experience (this is the beauty of Airbnb). Location slightly off-center compared to the area of ​​major tourist interest (20-25 minutes on foot from the river) but metro station (Trindade) very close. Teresa was extremely helpful. An experience to highly recommend.
Hands down one of the nicest AirBnBs I’ve ever stayed it. I have nothing but positive things to say. The view, decor and location are all fabulous.

This apartment was perfect for visiting Porto. Everything in the city was within easy reach. The metro was a few minutes walk. There is an excellent bakery for breakfast and many many bars/restaurants for the evening. We would definitely book again.

Awesome stay. Felt like a little beach house in the middle of Porto. Extremely close to popular sights and the metro/trains yet peaceful at night. Very comfortable with everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend

Beautiful apartment located in a peaceful area (great sleeps!) with amenities, wonderful restaurants and places to explore just minutes away. Check-in was simple and instructions were clear. The host was super friendly and gave us lots of great recommendations to make our stay easy.  The kitchen was perfect, lovely big bed and GREAT shower! The view from the bedroom is also spectacular to sit in bed and catch the sunrise from. Everywhere was spotless and exactly as described. I would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto. Thank you!

The apartment is cozy and bright.  Having breakfast on the terrace with such a beautiful view was a pleasure. Nearby are many restaurants to visit and places to walk.  Noise insulation is poor and we constantly heard our neighbors and felt them walking around in their apartments. In general, it was only disturbing at night. We were saved by earplugs, so our experience was not much ruined

Very nice place to stay in Povoa. Everything is provided for in the cute apartment. The hosts Victor and Barbara are so easy to communicate, check in and check out was hassle-free. Location is good and love my experience. I also love the little balcony both in front and in the back where I can see outside as I am very claustrophobic.

Celia's flat was really lovely, bigger than expected and had a surprise roof terrace with a view over the square. It's in a really central location and right next door to the famous bookshop. Thanks for having us!

Alexandra was the best! She met us for check in and even allowed us to check out later than expected. We appreciated that very much. She had excellent restaurant recommendations. Wonderful host! Would work with her again.
Great stay, the views from both balconies were incredible. Its a wonderfully central location. The steps are no joke, 4th floor. Would recommend to anyone looking to enjoy Porto.
We had a lovely stay. The apartment is in a great location, easy to walk to the train station, restaurants and shops. I’d highly recommend staying here!
Lovely apartment, well equipped and clean. Staff very responsive and helpful. Everything was on the spot except an unpleasant smell in the toilet, presumably from the drill.

We have enjoyed our stay for 2 nights in early November. The appartment is spacious, clean and nicely decorated. As it is very central, almost everything was within walking distance. Parking was also easy. Many thanks.

Hallo Porto firehouse was an perfect place to stay. The apartment was very clean, well equiped with everything you need. Away from citynoise but on walking distance of all nice shops and hip places to eat. We would certainly recommend it to anyone else. Porto is a great city for a weekend getaway.
The apartment was clean and spacious. Cristina was very kind en waited for us, the communication went smooth and quick. The apartment is well located near the city center, lots of restaurants nearby.
Really nice to have a large property with 6 double beds. Close to bars and restaurants and places of interest. The host was so helpful

Cesar was a great host. Always responsive with questions ahead of my arrival. I was delayed due to airline difficulties, but he was still available to meet me and explain everything about his place.  He also  had the  most thoughtful and thorough notebook on instructions, vital information, and helpful suggestions!  The place had all the basics I needed and was immaculately clean and charmingly decorated. Just one warning. There is no lift. There are 65 steps to climb with luggage!  I counted!

This location is fantastic, the apartment spotlessly clean and the responsiveness of the owner’s excellent. The amenities are as listed although I missed that there was no washing machine. Laundromats are close by. There is no aircon but every room had fans. The living space and main bedroom remained cool by keeping the windows open. This was harder to do for the second and third bedrooms  but fans kept the temperature down in those rooms. We loved the living space it was large,  roomy and airy.  The location was amazing there was nothing we couldn’t walk to. There are a few flights of stairs to climb but they were wide and easy to navigate.
The apartment is comfortable and well situated and our host was kind and very helpful. We had the possibility to leave our luggage before check-in and after check-out, which was very helpful
We had a great stay in this apartment. The host was very helpful and welcoming, the location was great, and the apartment was comfortable, spacious and clean.
Everything worked really great. The host team was very kind & helpful. Place looks great! Would. Totally recommend it to anyone else!

Location was great, but if you are a light sleeper this is not the place for you. The roads are cobblestone, so road noise from cars every 30 seconds all night is excessive with the very tight street this apartment is on the sound comes right in. If you wear earplugs, all is good, but if not, this is not a sound proof apartment.

This apartment is very clean, fully funished with anything a guest might want, tastefully decorated, and quiet. Very conveniently located to the Metro and only a few stops to the historic quarter. Maria Angela could not have communicated better. All information, with helpful images was provided at the right time. She provided a parking pass for underground parking nearby, which was very very helpful.
Amazing apartment situated in a perfect location for exploring beautiful Porto. We had a great time staying here. Would definitely recommend.

We just got home from our trip through Europe and by far, Luis’s place in Porto was our favorite. Luis was lovely and super helpful during check-in and communicated   quickly through message. Can’t recommend this place enough!

The apartment, in the city center, is very comfortable with a nice decoration. It includes all needed equipment. Hugo is very welcoming and thoughtfull.  However, the apartment is a bit noisy and make sure that you can let your luggage to the restaurant downstair otherwise you will have to take them with you the whole day when leaving (as it arrived to us)…

Wonderful apartment. It have all you need for a great stay in Porto. Super clean, great space and the location is just perfect. Communication with the host was fast and she was super helpful. Will stay here again if I am ever so lucky to come back to Porto again.
Cristina was great in helping us check in and out. Great views of the beach, spotless condition and well appointed. Thank you Ricardo and Cristina
Overall great experience, good location and price. Loved the backyard. The house also has air conditioning which was a great addition!

Really nice modern apartment set within an old town facade . Good to have a south facing balcony with view over towards the river . The location is perfect for all the shops , waterfront & restaurants . Check in and check out very easy with Maggie .
It was just perfect. We got all the help we needed and the host was very kind and reactive. The surroundings are perfect if you’re looking for a place in the vibrant part of the city centre!
Beautiful apartment. Stunning space, excellent bathroom/shower and comfortable bed. Loved our stay at this place, would recommend!
What a lovely place to stay, light, peaceful, with a beautiful plant filled balcony, extremely comfortable bed and Nuno, our host couldn’t have been more welcoming and helpful with all our requests
Lovely place for a stay in Porto. Well located, close enough to the main sites, easy to get around from and perfect for 1-3 people. No A/C though, so keep that in mind!

We never got to meet Helena. We were welcome by Eduardo instead, who kindly showed us the apartment and gave us the usual directions. He was very nice and helpful. We loved the apartment, a refurbished old flat, with high ceilings and big rooms. It is much bigger than it looks from the pictures.   The apartment was cold the first night, probably because it was empty the week before. Heating was set on and off automatically but It took that night and the following day to get to a comfortable temperature inside the house. At times it was colder inside than outside.  Location was good. Pretty close to Porto's city centre, but "far" enough to be quiet at night, which is especially interesting when you travel with kids.  muito obrigado!
Elio was wonderful to deal with and the apartment was fabulous.  Great location. East walk into town and a tram top outside.  Would highly recommend

Ana & Joao’s space was wonderful. The space was very modern & very clean. It was easy to walk everywhere. There are some nice restaurants & coffee shops right in the neighborhood. Also, they left us some port wine & cookies- a great special touch.  They were also very responsive.  I would definitely stay here again & recommend it to others.

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. Carla is a great host and there when you need her, Very nice and wants to share all she knows about the area. We had a great stay!

We had a very pleasant stay at the apartment. Enough space for two. Fully equipped kitchen and clean bathroom. The neighborhood was safe and there were restaurants and supermarket nearby. It takes almost 10-15 minutes walk to the city center. The host was always very responsive. We enjoyed our stay and we surely recommend it.

Dilia’s place is located in a vibrant part of old Porto.  She left a great summary of local dining/ drinking spots within minutes of apartment.  Her recommendations were excellent!  The apartment is as advertised, super clean, modern apartment.  Check in was easy.

The flat is lovely and Marina is a great host. The piano was a nice touch and well appreciated. It was a lovely and quiet area, 5 minutes walk from the nearest beach. Espinho is the nearest town with some really cheap places to eat out.

Enjoyed my stay here! Very clean and perfect for the solo traveler or couple. Host was very communicative with clear check-in instructions and left a physical key in case the code wouldn’t work. The location is very convenient and easily walkable to points of interest - and the balcony view of the church is beautiful. Just be aware that for the view, it’s a 4th floor walk-up with no elevator.

Nice flat, 5 mins walk to the restaurants along the riverfront. There is a view of the river, although don't expect one that's picturesque. There is a church opposite and the bells start chiming at 8.00 am. There is a small supermarket underneath, which is very handy.

Very nice and neat apartment, all amenities included, great location, spacious apartment. The bedroom window can’t be shut and allows a great deal of sunlight in the morning. A bit noisy due to wind. Great AC. It could had been a bit cleaner! Very nice experience and definitely recommend!
Ana and Joao were so accommodating. It was a fantastic location with everything you need for an amazing trip!
We stayed there just a weekend, but everything was good - accommodation, place, instruction, communication with host

Excellent location. Beautiful apartment, plenty of space. Having access to a private garage in Porto is awesome. Multiple AC in the apartment makes the premise comfortable. Very responsive host. However, outside balcony floor (on the last floor) is dangerous and needs to be changed. In general, very satisfied. Highly recommend.

I would highly recommend starting at Nuno’s apartment when visiting Porto. Upon arrival he gave our group a through tour of the apartment, and gave us recommendations on what to do and where to eat in Porto. The apartment itself was extremely tidy and clean, and was beautifully orchestrated with furniture, decor, and linens. The flat gets flooded with natural light. Would love to stay again:
Big light apartment in great place near old town. Very hospitable owner, gave us a lot of excellent advice on the city. We enjoyed meeting her and stay in the apartment!!!
This studio flat is in a great location - really central and a lovely street. The flat had everything we needed and was nice and spacious. We'll definitely be recommending it to friends and family.

The appartement was very modern, clean and cosy. This place is everything you need during a citytrip! Within 15 min you’re in the historical centrum or at the iconic bridge that’s crossing the Douro. Rui was very sympatic and helpful. We would definitly visit again!
Very nice play to book if you are travelling with more than 6 people. 15 min to the city center by car. Nice and calm neighborhood. We will book again !!

Margaridas apartment was beautifully decorated and in the perfect location. Right beside the river and allots of restaurants. Margarida had great communication and responded quickly. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed during our stay. I couldn’t recommend it enough!

This was in a great location - very near all the major sites, next to the nightlife, and several restaurants were located on the same block.  The apartment itself is huge and had thoughtful touches like mini shower gels, and coffee pods for the coffee maker.  Apartment was clean and check in was simple. Would definitely stay here again!

Chris's flat is clean, well placed between the beach and the city center, close to the metro station "Casa da musica" and very cozy. We had a great experience and this was thanks to Chris who took the time to show us the neighborhood and advice what to visit in Porto.

Vivian's place was better than the add showed,especially the terrace,which is fabulous to have breakfast or diner or just take in the sun. Very clean, well equipped, we stayed for 3 days and cooked all our meals there. Supermarket 5 min away, subway is 2 blocks down and we walk to the old city in less than half hour. Really good value for the money, I would highly recommand it. Vivian was there to greet us as we ask to check in early and she was very helpful and nice.

Had a little bit trouble to find the places by car. Only the car have a access code to enter. It was easy to get it and out. The place near river and lots to do around . Eduardo is really nice and quick response. He left a port wine on the table with five glasses. The room is clean and we felt like home. We will recommend our friends who come to Porto.

My husband and I had a great time staying at Eduardo and Helena’s apartment, very clean and functional and very accessible to the town centre and tourist attractions. Much appreciated the welcoming treats and friendly advice, they were both very quick to reply to all queries and prompt to come over to the apartment when/if needed. I would recommend their accommodation without hesitation.
Anytime you visit Porto, you always have to stay at Carmo's place! It's the best. As usual, I had a great stay at Carmo's place.
Amazing location and very reasonably priced! Excellent for two couples as their were two bathrooms and the rooms weren’t right on top of each other.

We couldn’t have asked for a more ideal location for our long weekend in Porto. The apt. was clean and modern with great views. Checkin went smooth and we were offered some great tips on places to visit and eat.

Great neighborhood and the windows really kept out the street noise. The bed was comfortable and large. No ac that we could find but we really didn’t need it. The decor was exactly as shown in the photos.

The stay was absolutely great! The apartment is compact, cozy, and fully equipped with everything you might need. The location is perfect — right in the heart of Porto. Pedro provided detailed instructions for check-in and was very attentive to every detail. Everything went smoothly, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommend!

Beautiful apartment in a great location! We even received a wine and cookies from Porto! There was even a blow dryer with a diffuser which our curly hair needed! Would stay here again in a heartbeat! Thank you!
What a fantastic experience! We stayed as a family, and Rui helped us with local tours and experiences. A one stop service in a great location! We would highly recommend!

I had such a wonderful stay at Susana’s place. The accommodation was perfect for a short stay and felt very comfortable. It is in a great location and you can walk easily to all the main attractions. Plus there are plenty of cafés, restaurants and shops around. Susana herself is a great host and always very responsive and helpful. I wish I could have stayed longer.
Come with a light bag when you are staying at the top floor. Very helpful host. Great nightlife and restaurants at a stone drop distance.

Great location, nice, quiet and clean apt. Plenty of options for restaurants, groceries and cafés nearby. The only thing to point out is there is no "central heating" but rather a space heater in the room, not necessarily a bad thing, just not what I was expecting.  Overall great experience, would recommend!

Fantastic place! If we are ever in Porto again, we will hopefully stay here. The location is great and very easy to get to from the airport train. The space was extremely clean and tidy and had all the amenities needed for a stay.

On our recent trip to Porto we stayed at Joao and Andrea’s place and it was just perfect for the four of us. The accommodations were clean and the location perfect for getting around town. We took Bolt ride service as well and never had an issue. The only thing I feel it was missing was a basic coffee maker. There was an espresso machine but we don’t drink that.  I would definitely recommend this place for anyone visiting beautiful Porto. Perfect place for two couples or a family of four.
We had a great time at the Almada 329 apartment in Porto. The apartment is well located. It is very well equipped and absolutely clean. Mario was very friendly and organised us a cab to the airport.

It became a perfect home for 3days stay with good location. We can go San-bento station just by 10m walking. Area near B&B was not crowded, so good for rest at night too. House was really clean and morden. Everything we need was perfectly ready.  Host was so kind and did his best for comport staying for every aspects from preparation, finding location, suprising welcome gifts, warm explanation for the city and easy check-out.  Staying here make us feel Porto city itself as more attractive and warm place! I strongly recommend to stay here!

Pedro and Ricardo’s welcome on the first day of our stay was wonderful.  The apartment itself was clean and well appointed and as advertised. Expectations met. We would highly recommend to anyone staying in Porto.
The place was in a good neighborhood, but the furniture was pretty uncomfortable and not exactly what was pictured in the listing.
The apartment was fantastic! It looked even better than the photos. In easy walking distance to all of Porto’s attractions and centre.

Our stay was perfect, the apartment looks exactly like the photos, it’s really clean and functional.  It’s really close to beautiful touristic areas! Overall we really recommend coming to Oporto and staying in this flat!
Susana’s place was the perfect place to stay for exploring Porto. The neighborhood has a lively vibe and the apartment is cozy and comfortable. We had a lovely time there!

This was one of the best AirBnB experiences I’ve had. It is beautiful — nice touches and style. Feels sexy! Love the blue. Notably — at check the host spent time to cover local sights and restaurants. LOTS of recommendations! Helped me get oriented, which was key as a first time visitor to Porto.  Most of all, I had transportation problems (which you never want to- stressful!). The host was very kind and went beyond expectations to help me sort that out. Not expected, but so appreciated. Cannot recommend enough. Thank you! 💖

The apartment is very new and very modern. It was nice to stay there! The only negative thing would be that the pull out bed wasn’t very comfortable. Everything else was great and Ilan was very easy to communicate with, especially for instructions on how to get to the apartment.

The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood abt 15 mins walk from Trindade Metro. The living area and bedroom are spacious and you can hear the birds whilst in courtyard. The clothes drying rack was very useful. We appreciated the sight seeing and traditional restuarant tips. We especially liked lunch at Restaurante Braganza and the seafood experience at Tito ll. We appreciated your prompt responses when needed.

Never met the son. Moma has her own agenda. Don't waste your time with her. All she did was send us to a construction site once we refused to buy the tours she sells. Apartment was very nice, well located but on a very noisy street. Ok if you can keep the windows closed.

Catarina’s home was a great place for our month long trip to Portugal.  The apartment has all that you need for a short or long stay. The transport to and from the airport was particularly thoughtful.  The quick access to the metro stop is a must to get around the city.  We bought a monthly metro pass which I think would be worth it for even a two week stay instead of having to deal with purchasing tickets for individual daily trips. The pass includes metro and bus.  We still walked a lot!  Catarina and Antonio were very responsive if we needed anything.  We absolutely enjoyed our stay!
What a great host Took the time to describe the area attractions, restaurants and shopping. Great experience
Absolutely amazing apartment in a perfect location. All the amenities were up to standard and the space was sparkling clean. Dino and Ines made the stay a 10/10. Thank you and we will be returning!
It was a fairly decent spot. A little outside of the city center but a great place for accommodation.

The place was such a perfect location to access so much in Porto. We walked to everything- the river, many historical sites, restaurants, arts, and cultural attractions. We loved the modern design and layout of the place. Our host was very responsive. Highly recommend!
We loved our stay at Ilan’s place. It was in the perfect location, it matched the photos, was very clean and the furnishings were beautiful! We would definitely recommend!
Sergio went above and beyond for accommodating my family and I. He was super responsive and helpful. I would recommend this beautiful, spacious house.
The property was well worth the money just for the location. It was very clean and tidy and quiet. Great for a short stay.
Higly recommanded! Big hospitality, great house with each a privat bathroom, very clean. Very handy outdoor kitchen and bathroom.  Very correct person, don't hesitate to book.
Great accommodations, great communication and flexibility by host. Clean, nice location, wonderful view of garden area in the back. Would definitely stay again.
Pedro was an excellent host, we only had 3 days and he provided great activities for using the time available.

This spot is in an excellent location and is very walkable from most major attractions in Porto. During check-in, figuring out the doorknob was a bit of a challenge, but once we understood how to work the door key, there was no issue (thanks for the host's responsiveness). The place was relatively clean - some dust and stains that we tidied up, but nothing absolutely glaring. I would recommend this place during the cooler months as there is no central AC as stated in the listing and the bedroom can get quite warm. Also as someone with back pain, I would say the mattress was not the best for my lower back. My friend would also wake up with stiffness in the mornings. Overall, the size, location, and amenities are just what we needed for our first time visiting Porto.

The place is absolutely wonderful and feels warm and welcoming. It is very clean and has everything you need. Check-in went very smooth and we got some nice tips for restaurants and cafés. The apartment is located in the heart of Oporto and that is a big plus. Grocery store and nice restaurants, bars, shops and the train station and bus stops are around the corner.
The accompdstion was in a great location to exlplore Lisbon. Marco was responsive and was very helpful in making our stay extremely comfortable.

Tina was a very friendly host and sent us a lot of recommendations. Her dogs are also very cute! Unfortunately, during our stay, there was both a heat wave and low tide so opening the window would let in a sewage-like smell. Tina graciously provided a fan outside of the listed accommodations, which made things a little better, but we found ourselves in a catch-22 situation of having either a hot or smelly room. Combined with the slight smoke and dog smells, it was a bit hard to sleep at night. Overall, however, it was a very peaceful and convenient location. There’s a grocery store nearby, and it’s easy to walk to both the Porto city center and to the seaside.
Joaquim's accomodation was excellently located and very affordable. he was proactive with my questions and we had a lovely time. thank you so much!
We had a fantastic stay at Constantino's place. It was nice and clean, comfortable and equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Thanks and we hope to be back again!

We really enjoyed staying at Porto Je T’Aime, I even would love to stay there longer :) A very nice place, tidy and it’s in a very good location, it’s comfortable to reach best Porto places. I’m also very grateful for the host for a very warm meeting. It was nice that two people speaking in two different language can understand each other.

The apartment is nice and clean. Lucia is an amazing host and very friendly. The apartment has everything you need for a couple days in Porto. It is very close to the port wine cellars and the waterfront and about 20‘ walk to the city center. But everything is easily accessible. Overall a highly recommend accommodation
Lovely home and Thiago was very helpful at check in. 5 mins walk from the main square and a great little flat with good facilities. Just what we wanted! Thanks!
Unfortunately, had to cancel the trip to Portugal last minute, but host was responsive in the lead up. Wish we could have stayed at Hugo's place!
The room was super clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Its location was perfect, close to all the main sightseeing spots. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area!

Daniel welcomed us in person and he gave us some great recommendations and was also really helpful with quickly organizing baby equipment for us even though it was a really last minute request. His place is really clean, comfortable, well equipped and most importantly really well located. It is in walking distance to some great food points (a must go restaurants is Porto) as well as the city center. I strongly recommend Daniel's place to anyone who wants to have a nice stay in Porto!

Hugo’s place was exactly as described and even better in person! Truly in an impeccable location too. Checking in was seamless with very clear and easy instructions to follow. We were welcomed to some fresh port wine and a stunning space. I can’t wait to stay in Porto again, def would want to stay in the same home!

Maria welcomed my family and I to her beautiful city of Porto. She made us feel welcome as when we first met her, she had a big smile as she could not wait to show us the beautiful apartment and tell us places to see and restaurants to visit.  The balcony was approachable from 2 bedrooms and the living room, and it provided a beautiful view of the city. The living room, dining room and kitchen are very spacious and allowed the 7 of us to have a place to sit down, relax and talk about what we experienced each day in this beautiful culture. The apartment was in the city and close to restaurants, bakeries, stores, etc. The Portuguese people in each restaurant that we went to were extremely warm and welcomed us as we entered their establishment. What a beautiful experience my family and I had.

The apartment was clean and very practical. The bed is huge. All equipment was operational. The location is very nice, to all major attractions were easily accessible on foot. The only ocean was a bit far, but with good public transport. I recommended.

The apartment is in a great location, close to attractions, transport, restaurants, the river. Easy to walk to many locations. Hosts Christina & Carlos met us on arrival and Christina gave us lots of helpful information. Would happily stay here next time we visit Porto

Place is in a great location! Catch the sunset just a few blocks away, great food near by and easy access to transportation. It was location above a bar so it did get a little noisy at night but it mostly got quiet after 1am. I do recommend the location regardless.
Joâo was great from the beginning. He was reactive, patient and friendly.  The place is lovely, perfectly located and easy to find.

Sonia is a wonderful host. She helped us with everything from our arrival at the airport to giving us typical shops' addresses and visits not to miss out on. Her appartment is perfectly furnished and well located. You will not be disappointed. I highly recommand this place.

It's just as good as in the pictures. Close to center, clean and cozy apartment. Communications went very smooth and quick although we've actually did not see each other in person. Highly recommended.

Irene was the perfect host, and the flat was even better than it looks on the pictures. She was extremely helpful with tips etc during our stay, would definitely come back. Only downside was construction nearby which was a bit loud at some points. But everything else was perfect and will definitely recommend this.

The apartment is really great , it is located in a central location , it is spacious and clean. The kitchen is comfortable and well equipped. The apartment is in a high position of the city and Therefore the terrace offers a panoramic view of the city (you can see the Douro River and Vila Nova de Gaia) . The welcome from the host was really satisfying . He described us in detail all the major points of interest of the city. I highly recommend this apartment for a special stay in Porto.

Such a great cute space!  And RIGHT downtown.  Near everything - convenience store across the street - umbrella store for the rain - cafe and restaurants steps away. I slept downstairs and my daughter slept in the low ceiling loft - incredible value. I would highly recommend and I’d certainly stay again.

Very nice and clean apartment, just around the corner to the beach. It was in a good location. Only 20 minutes away by taxi (cost roughly 8-10 euros) to Casa da musical and 5 minutes walk to the beach. The description of the apartment is accurate. I'll definitely go back to the apartment one day, we will come back here, no doubt...
Amazing views, great location! In-person check-in was very helpful and the host was really responsive whenever we had any questions. We really enjoyed our short stay here.
Love this place, it is clean and stylish with amazing showers👌🏾 The balcony is lovely and location is convenient.

We had a very nice stay at Hugo flat. Perfectly located and very well decorated, it really made us enjoy our stay in Porto. Easy to find, easy to park the car.  Hugo has been lovely from day one helping us with the check in but also with some advices and very good addresses.  The perfect stay for a weekend in Porto

Amazing place with an unforgetable view over the Douro river :) very nice furnished, very clean + the host very friendly and informative. Even if our flights were delayed for several hours and we arrived very late in the night, she accomodated us very friendly and took the time to recommend us good restaurants to eat and nice places to visit. We would definetly come back here. Highly recommended!

What an absolutely spectacular apartment!  Your view will be looking out with an unobstructed view over the river and across to the port wine houses in Gaia.  We could have stared out the window all day.  Everything was very beautiful and comfortable.  It was also remarkably quiet considering the location immediately by the river.  We really didn't hear any noise at night at all.  Filipa's restaurant is also a must to enjoy!

An amazing host with an authentic, historic and warm apartment that gave us the perfect place to explore this terrific city...an absolute highlight of our twenty day adventure to Portugal! The location is unbeatable, the garden as lovely as it appears in the pictures (and yes, that is the view!) and so much room. Our only regret was not planning our trip so we spent more time here. Next time...thank you, Alex!

Hugo made us feel welcome and gave us many tips on what to see and do. We had lost our luggage and Hugo helped us with the delivery of the suitcases and taking care of the communication with the delivery staff, allowing us to enjoy our stay in Porto. The studio is very nice, close to the attractions you want to see. Highly recommended!
Perfect location. Comfortable unit. We used the courtyard and the washer. Next time in Porto we will try to stay again.   An so many restaurants close by. Thank you.
Great place to stay in Porto :-). The place is in a really pretty and convenient spot in the city and the apartment itself is very nice! The host is also very nice and accommodating
You will probably find lots of places to stay in porto, but this place is the best, take it from someone who stayed here x

The stay was very good. The location of the house is perfect. You can get to the city centre very quickly on foot or with the Uber. The free parking is really good. But the highlight was the very tasty breakfast and the nice contact to the host.
Nice place in the middle of old town. Great host who share tips and trick with us.Would definitely return.

Angelo and Antonia are very friendly, kind and helpful. We could have count on them at any time. They were constantly in touch with us. The house is comfortable and full equiped. The distance to the sea was aproximently 15 min walk. Also, there is a garden included with a lot of fruit trees. The area is quiet and the neighbourhood is also peaceful. We can absolutly recommend this house for anyone, who wish to spend nice time in a beautiful surrounding.

The apartment is great for a weekend break in Porto. Check in and communication was smooth, it has everything you need and is in a perfect location. Make sure to try the pasteis de nata from across the road too!
Great apartment with everything we needed during our stay. Centrally located, but quiet place. The host was always helpful and the communication smooth. I surely recommend!
Everything was perfect ! The studio is extremly well situated ! Our weekend was amazing !  Thanks Carla !

The check-in was very easy to do, with clear isntructions. The location was very good. Although it was very close to the station, the noise did not reach the apartment. There were many good public transport connections, and it was close to the city centre. The bathroom and the shower were good. The kitchen was well equipped. The communication with the hosts was very good, very responsive. Some technical things weren't working at first, but when we informed, they very quickly took care of it. The ACs were working well, which was good. The apartment building - although made from concrete - was covered with metallic cover, which was surprising to us. But it seems this was quite common in Porto.

Pedro was such a lovely host and very responsive. The airbnb felt like a mini hotel room in the heart of Porto. The bed was comfortable and the pillows felt luxurious. The bathroom was clean and well lit. There were lots of plugs available. The location was perfect, quiet and walkable to restaurants, clubs and attractions. Pedro also was very accommodating as we had an evening flight and needed to leave our bags with him. Would come back here and highly recommend.
Ana was an excellent host, her home is a beautiful place filled with vintage furniture in a quiet neighborhood. Next time I visit Porto I would be happy to stay here again.

Joana and Diogo's place is a very cool renovation of an old stone building and the location near the river makes it easy to catch the #1 tram (a not-to-be-missed experience!) or walk over the hill into the heart of the big, beautiful historic district. Several food options by the river are within easy walking distance too.

Great location for all the sights of Porto. Need to be physically fit as it’s on a steep hill but so is most of Porto! Easy check in and accommodation was as described, very comfy and quiet at night.  Susana arranged our return taxi which turned up on time as requested.  Would recommend this accommodation.

Amazing place! Everything that we needed was there. Communication with Rui was quick and easy. Rooms were all clean. Good location and we got some nice tips of things to do in Porto. Would definitely recommend!

Everything could of been fine, but finding bed bugs all over the place in the middle of the night after some of it jumped on us and bite was traumatic.  They seemed to have been there for while since the amount and the sizes were massive.  It needs to be checked more often.  Apart that, it’s a nice small apartment

Great stay! Not complaints. Paulo was super responsive but we didn’t need a lot of assistance either. He allowed us to check in early because we had an early flight and he gave recommendation for laundry services. The place is near everything you need!
Ana's place is in an amazing location with really good wifi! (Something we struggled to find in Portugal)  Very comfortable and homey feeling. Would recommend

Much better than expected, perfect stay at Hugo's. Communication is quick and efficient, place is stylish, cosy and totally clean, it's in the historical old Porto building. Very strategic location, in the centre of (night and day) life yet calm place.  Will recommend the place and come again!
Brand new apartment, beautifully decorated, convenient location to sights, shops, and restaurants.  Very clean and comfortable! We would stay here again!

This place is as good as a hotel if not better!. Stylish apartment, just like photos, very clean and has all that you need. Place is cosy, good for 1 or 2 pax but not more. Bed was also super comfy we had such good sleep during this Porto leg. The AC was a great respite in the heat of summer where temperatures were close to 35deg. They also gave an extra set of towels for our stay which was much appreciated.  Location was also fantastic. We didn’t even take any public transport because everything was in walking distance! Many stylish bars and cafes close by. We met with filipa who was really friendly and gave us plenty of tips for food and things to do. We wanted to do the duoro river tour and they arranged it for us wo any hassle. Highly recommended, I wouldn’t hesitate to book if I were you!
The house was just perfect, beautiful and in a perfect position. I really had great time in it.  Marco was really nice and available for everything we needed.  Just go there!  Andrea
Great place to stay. Super new cozy flat, close to shops and other things. Highly advise this place.  Thank you 😊
Lovely flat with a stunning view over the river. Only a short walk from the old town and conveniently close to the port cellars! Pedro gave us lots of useful information and tips on where to go.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is well decorated and tidy, and has everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The location couldn’t have been better for exploring the city of Porto and all the best views are nearby. We’d happily recommend staying here!
Very central location . Very near to Clerigos Tower and a multitude of parks, Warm reception , there was a bottle of excellent on the kitchen table.
Hidden gem in urban setting, with rare outside space. Well-appointed kitchen. Note that there are many interior stairs, but felt safe. Several very nice extras included. Thank you, Sonia!

What a spot!  The location somehow manages to be steps from the restaurant and vendor scene by the river and at the same time feel like a peaceful oasis where the city can't get to you. Everything was perfect with our stay from the optional transfer from the airport, to a great talk on local history and recommendations, to the actual physical space itself.  And the views - wow.  You'll be gazing from the heights of the Gaia neighborhood across the river to old town Porto.  We loved Pedro's place and would stay there again without question.
Amazing location with some of the best views of Porto. I would definitely recommend staying here. The hosts are lovely, and the place is amazing
Very cut flat, well located (10 minutes walk from the city center and next to a metro station), very luminous et well decorated. We had a very nice moment there ! I recommend it !

We really enjoyed our stay with Porto City Hosts. Friendly and very responsive to our questions. The apartment has everything you need and in a very central walkable location. We are so grateful to Joao for his EXECELLENT local food recommendations. Easily the best places we’ve eaten on the entire trip. We hope to stay here again in the future!! Obrigado!!
This was a great place! Incredible locations, good amenities and the hosts were extremely kind and responsive. Really enjoyed my stay!

Bernardo and Suzana were great hosts. They were very friendly and helpful, and made me feel like at home. The beach house is big enough for two persons. It's well-equipped, well-furnished, clean, and quite close to the beach and a supermarket. The only thing is, if you go there by bus, you should be careful since google doesn't know the bus routes in the area. It was one of my greatest experiences on airbnb. I will definitely come back one day!

This apartment is ideal in every way! Perfect location and comfortable space with everything you need. I stayed a month and didn’t want to leave! Cristina responds quickly with questions and is a warm hostess that works hard to keep her guests happy. 5 stars!!!
We really enjoyed our stay! We were surprised by how this lovely stay is in the middle of the Porto historical center. We are definitely coming back!
A lovely loft in the heart of Porto. The flat is nice, modern, very stylish, have everything that you need. Nuno was a great host. I recommend it!

Sofia’s place was absolutely beautiful & so comfortable! The location was perfect - close to everything yet not loud at all. She provided all the necessities to make our stay fantastic! Would definitely return! ❤️

Vitor's place was really lovely and cozy, great location for exploring Porto. Kettle with tea provided and having a fridge was handy. Quite loud at night so take earplugs if you're a light sleeper :) would defo stay here again!

Amazing place to stay.  Location was perfect as it is a 5-15min walk to nearly everything; including crossing over the bridge to Gaia The views from the balcony were always stunning and we found ourselves out there quite a bit. Alex was very helpful and responsive provided us a local map where he pinpointed good food places and places to see. Would 100% stay again and recommend

Florinda was a warm, kind, organized, and extremely accommodating host. Her place was spotless and was exactly central to all of our Porto destinations. The city view from the balcony is miraculous. Checkin was simple with the option for luggage storage, and the space was large and comfortable. I’d highly recommend staying here. The only thing to note is that soap and shampoo were not included so be sure to bring your own!

We had an amazing time in Porto! Catarina was a great host being very flexible with check-in and check-out times! She also gave us great tips on what to see around the city. The best feature of the apartment is by far the location. The apartment is in a quite area, but all tourist attractions are still reachable by foot. Thank you very much for hosting us!

This was a terrific location to explore Porto.  Comfortable beds, great communication from hosts (who conveyed some minor issues from the previous guests), and surprisingly somewhat quiet considering despite being in the middle of historic Porto.
Thank you for a nice stay.  Sadly we had in Porto one night stay only , but we will be back….
The reality was better that the description. Fantastic apartment, convenient location, greate smooth service. For a group of people, this is as good as it can get.

This place was stunning and so peaceful!  The windows opened up to a gorgeous view of the Duoro River, and I sat on the cushions relaxing, watching cats meander the rooftops and locals sip beer on the streets.  The place was super clean and comfortable.  It was truly a treat to stay here.

Our first visit to Portugal traveling to Porto, Lisbon and Lagos not knowing what expect . This airbnb was in the perfect location in the historic district. Everything in walking distance, cafes, patios, restaurants, bars and bakeries. Custard tarts everyday. We loved it. Tours are great, the Duro Valley Wine tour is a must do. the unit exceeded our expectations and was a perfect fit for us. We highly recommend it.  Claudia was amazing and an attentive host. Quick to respond and answered our question. Our plane was a day late and we kept in contact.

This is an appartement hôtel with multiple appartements in the same building. Easy to manage. The check in was smooth although the cleaning lady does not speak English there was clear instruction and detailed trip advice left for us.  The appartement was on the last floor so a lot of stairs to climb. Super clean and all facilities run well. The beds are bit too soft to our taste and two rooms have no outside window so can be bit hot depending on the season. The whole floor is leaning badly as the building must be very old. Sometimes you feel dizzy walking or standing in the room. Excellent location! Enjoyed it very much. Thank you.
Lovely apartment, great central location, enjoyed the tarrace a lot. No problem with check in or out, swift communication with the owner. Would recommend to any traveler.

Susana was a great host: helpful, flexible, responsive and very attentive to guests’ needs and schedule.   We absolutely enjoyed our stay end-to-end:  cozy stylish apartment, lots of space, fully equipped kitchen, spotless cleanness everywhere and supreme location.  Susana and this nice flat truly overachieved expectations and we would love to come back again!

This apartment was fantastic! The best thing about it is the location - right within the heart of downtown Porto. Everything is within walking distance! The apartment was very clean, and the kitchen comes with all the essentials. Tomas and Sophia were wonderful with communication. We tried several of Sophia's recommendations (including the Francesinha at Cafe Santiago and port tasting at Ferreira), and everything was great. We would definitely stay here again!

Dino and Ines place is great. We were welcomed with a welcome basket of local goods. It was all excellent. The accommodations were amazing. The place was very stylish and comfortable. We felt very safe. Dino did a very good job offering suggestions and guiding us through the must see and eat places. I would absolutely recommend and would absolutely visit again.  Thanks Dino and Ines.
Wonderful.  Beautiful apartment very central to the heart of a beautiful city.  Would definitely recommend.

Very nice, big and cosy appartment, in the centre of town, with a patio and a very nice terrace! Very warm welcome from Alaina and Alex! Am ideal place to discover Porto and an excellent value for money.
Modern,  renovated and clean flat in the middle of Porto. Great location walking distance from restaurants, shopping and attractions. Hospitality and service was top notch
Beautiful spot in a perfect location! The apartment was impeccably maintained and offered a comfortable oasis within the heart of Porto. Couldn’t recommend Eugenia and Luis’ place highly enough.

Amazing apartment, great communication with Ruis and Simon. Loved the bedrooms and the bathrooms, enjoyed on the balcony with the tanning beds and definitely an apartment that I will recommend. Loved our stay, thank you 😊
Perfect location.  Modern and very clean apartment.  Very responsive and helpful host.  I highly recommend it!

Wonderful stay in Porto and the apartment on the first floor was perfect for our needs. Susanna and Pedro were available for a very late check in and we had no problems whatsoever with the accommodation … also a nice spot of port left for our arrival …

I loved this apartment, not just because it's beautiful design and it's perfect location but also because of it's host Luis. Luís was really nice more than expected he gave us all the best tips, and made us feel at home with some treats he made specially for us. An absolute pleasure is guaranteed with this one. ENJOY ;)
It's a really nice flat in a really nice location, wit a really nice view and a really nice host!
Perfect apartament with great windows and natural light all day, very cozy, silent by the night and a walk in location to every corner of the city ❤️

Pictures are accurate reflection of apartment.  great location, and nice and quite, good bed, basic kitchen.  Week long stay let down by lack of basics like dishwashing liquid, rubbish bags and tea coffee. little things which you expect hosts to provide for a short stay.

It was my best airbnb experience ever. João is fantastic host - very kind, attentive and accurate. The apartment itself was much better than I expected. Location is great - walking distanse to everywhere we wanted to go, but quiet at the same time. There’s also a fantastic panoramic view from the windows. The apartment had all we needed, even the dishwasher and coffee maker. This lovely apartment became our sweet home for few days. Thank you João!

Everything you need is here.  The perfect location, the elevator, the outdoor space, the ideal hosts.  This place has It all.  I don't have one but of feedback that is not 100% positive.  If It is available I would stay here every time I am in Porto!  Bravo to these wonderful hosts.  This is the ideal top notch Airbnb!!!!

The photos don’t lie - the view is amazing. The bedroom is in the back with the kitchen and bathroom between you and the living room so it’s a lovely dark quiet chamber to rest in.  Very comfortable, close to anything you’d want. 5 min walk takes you to a dozen different spots in Porto.

From the moment we arrived, we felt completely at home. Our hosts Helena and Miguel are not only generous and thoughtful, but truly great human beings. The neighbors were also incredibly welcoming and kind, adding to the warm, community authentic feel of the whole stay. The house is a gem, confortable for our family of four — uniquely renovated with so much character and history, just steps from Porto. Every detail reflects care and creativity. We’re so grateful for this experience and hope to return someday!

Rafael's place is perfect for a couple, the location is walking distance to the centre and the ribeira.  Even though the flat overlooks a noisy road the double glazing ensures that there is no noise. Couldn't have asked for a better place. Thoroughly recommend it.

The only place we'll be staying when we're in Porto from now. The space was modern, clean and spacious for the 2 of us. We felt safe both in the unit and the surrounding neighborhood. No outside noise to disrupt the sleep. Thank you Pedro for meeting us in the early morning to store our luggage before check-in and giving us an intimate tour of the local joints. Location surpassed our expectations. We'll be back.

We loved our stay. Perfect location, very clean and wonderful space that perfectly matched photos/description. Host was very responsive, accommodating, and helpful throughout. When visiting Porto again, will definitely book here again!

Stayed here for a weekend & it was great! Unit was clean & the host was very responsive. The location is also great right in the middle of the city - which was a little loud due to construction at this moment but definitely not too bad because there was nothing overnight. The unit is also beautiful inside and includes three balcony windows to see the view of the classic Portuguese tiles.

It looks plain on the outside but it is very cozy, clean, contemporary and comfortable inside. Great location - it is within minutes of easy walking to train station, which whisk you to downtown attractions. Parking is easy. This unit is equipped with all the you will need.
Florinda was very welcoming with a lot of great recommendations. Perfect host that knows Porto better than anyone!

This place was great. Diogo met us upon our arrival at the house. Took the time to go over a local map, give us recommendations for restaurants and activities. Even made a reservation for us at a place we couldn’t get into. Very responsive and communicative host. Beds were very comfortable. Great location. Felt safe. Nice touches with some snacks, wine, tea and coffee.  Highly recommend their place for any stay in Porto.

We have had an excellent experience staying at Juliana's place. Apart from the area where the apartment is located which we already knew, we were very positively impressed by the welcoming attitude from Juliana. We have been received warmly with typical Portuguese cookies and Juliana promptly showed us the apartment. We were not expecting such a nice functional apartment which immediately felt like home and is much bigger than what the photos show. Amenities we carefully placed everywhere and the heating during this colder season  works very well. Juliana took the time upon our arrival to provide us with information about the city but we mentioned we were familiar and had a very nice chat. Unfortunately it was raining and we couldn't enjoy the nice terrace on the ground floor which we hope to have the opportunity to do during one of our next stays in Porto. We thank Juliana for this awesome experience and hope to meet her sometime soon.
Great place,  very clean and with everything needed. Also in an ideal location in the city.

The warmest, most attentive host - talking to her felt like talking to a friend. The flat has everything that a small family might need, also the location was very good. Although it’s on a quite busy street, the traffic doesn’t disturb that much and there is plenty of privacy. For some reason this place made us feel truly cared for.

Wow what a place. Beautiful, clean, had everything we needed and more! Perfect location, easy access and the cutest tea house right in front.  Would absolutely recommend this place and we will return 🥰

Location Location Location! The Home Me's apartment is in the best location in town, everything is in a waking distance, the best restaurants 1-5  min.  all the communication with Home Me was great, the apartment was clean with everything you need, they welcomed us when arriving giving us great tips for the town. Highly recommended.
Great apartment in a great location. The terrace is amazing and the apartment has everything you will need to make your stay in Porto perfect. I’d definitely stay again and recommend it.
This is a great little apartment right in the centre of Porto. Everything was walkable and the apartment was lovely and quiet.

The apartment is nice and very well located. Pedro was an excellent host eager to give you any information you may need to go around the city andhe was very flexible on the time of departure. One con though, the floor is a bit creaky so i woke up sometimes in the middle of the night because the other guests were walking in the corridor...
Paula’s place is well located. It is walkable to the downtown area which has lots of shopping.
Lucia and Daniel’s place is beautiful in a lovely quiet neighbourhood of Porto. Just what I was looking for. Thank you!

We enjoyed our stay in Helena and Eudouro 's house and 100% recommend. It's closed to everywhere(15mins to 20mins walking distance to the main tourist attractions), there's nearby metro station to the airport. Quiet and safe neighbourhood,  great supermarkets nearby. The flat is comfortable and roomy, the bed is so comfortable, kitchen is well equipped. The hosts are very friendly and flexible about check in and out,  worth every penny to stay with them.

We stayed at Pedro’s place for two days and we didn’t want to leave. It’s an amazing location with a terrific view to the city. The apartment is very clean and comfortable and it has everything needed for a pleasant stay.
Really nice host and the location is near by the centrum of the city so you can easily get to the main attractions by foot.  Nice Air-bnb with a cute balcony.  Thanks for having me!

My parents and I stayed at this place for one night. It was perfect for us. The apartment is really close to the water and really easy to walk to from the main train station or wherever in Porto you arrive. The hosts were very responsive and kind. There is a nice kitchen if you would like to make food while you are there. If you need a grocery store, my mom and i walked about 2 km down the river. Otherwise, there is a tiny shop around the corner. Perfect for a short stay in Porto.
It‘s a quite and lovely place. Amazing location. If you need to calm down, this is perfect. Totally recommended.

I stayed in this apartment for a week and it was great! It had all of the amenities that you need for a comfortable stay - coffee maker, fridge, air conditioning, and good wifi. The location was great and felt very safe, with plenty of restaurants and places to go right in the vicinity, nearby public transportation, and a short walk to the Sao Bento train station and historic attractions. I would definitely stay here again.
I was a great time in Porto! This flat is perfect for 2 people and Elena was very helpful

Stayed for a short while but thought that this place was fantastic! Instructions from the host were very clear and location was very convenient! I would definitely recommend if you have a small group (1-3 people) and you want to be close to public transportation :)

the place is very small but cozy at the same time, it’s in the heart of the city and highly comfortable for everything: if you need something cheap but easy to reach, this is your place! pedro welcomed us and was very kind :)

Amazing location, a short walk to restaurants and sightseeing spots as well as travel links throughout the city and to the seaside. The balcony was lovely with a lot of afternoon sun and the room was pleasantly decorated with everything you could need. The hosts were great with a lot of information about the city which really helped us enjoy our time in the city. Would love to visit again, thank you!

Host (Neo) could not have been friendlier or more helpful.  Best Airbnb we had on our two-week, 4-city tour of Spain and Portugal.  Exactly as described. Everything is brand new.  Having washer/dryer in unit is a tremendous bonus when you are on an extended holiday.   Great location.  Porto is fantastic.

We can 100% recommend our stay with Alvaro. Alvaro is super helpful, he welcomed us right away and we were able to drop off our luggage even though we arrived at 7am. We immediately felt comfortable in the flat and small attentions, such as fresh oranges, made the stay perfect.

Absolutely wonderful stay! Eva and Dani’s place is well appointed, comfortable, and beautiful! Check-in was fast and easy, thanks to the clear communication with Eva and Dani. Everything was as it was stated in the listing and met all of our needs. The location (very central) and view from the apartment are incredible and I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto!

We had a great stay,  apartment was as described. The beds were of good quality,  kitchen was clean and well equipped. The two balconies on both sides of the house offer nice opportunities to be outside.
Great view of the ocean, parking was convenient, quiet and close to our location, very pleasant host and no problems whatsoever.
Pros - location is great - flat is super unique - free parking so so key - felt safe  Cons - mattress wasn't the best if that's important to you - some dirty dishes in cupboards
It's the best location, thank you for the host's consideration. If I travel to Portugal, I will stay here again.
Overall is OK Location is well, although a bit noisy Baby equipment was excellent Bathrooms  are a bit mouldy Parking situation is well
Beautiful, modern, clean apartment.  Walking distance to shops & River.  Traffic noise a bit loud but otherwise had a fantastic stay.

Very nice apartment, everything was like in the description, nice location for exploring the beautiful city of Porto. We can definitely recommend staying here for some days and would always come back again.
Great appartement. We got there later than the supposed hour and the owner didn’t make us pay a dime ! Always appreciated, + the owner is really nice and helpful. +++
All good. Top floor therefore not many issues with noises except for loud guests and metro construction site outside. But nice 😊

Sonia was a brilliant host – always getting back to our emails within minutes. The property was very clean and modern with comfy beds and all facilities including hair dryers, tea coffees etc. The location was fantastic, Would definitely stay here again. The best Airbnb we’ve ever been to and Sónia is the best host.

Great place and location (crazy view!). Look as good as the pictures! Communication with Pedro was easy and he was quick to reply, and offered good recommendations. The check in process was smooth as well Recommend the place!

I had some issues with my flight from Manchester and was not able to come to Porto. Unfortunately, I have lost quite some money on a plane ticket, and now accommodation. I canceled the reservation before the time it was supposed to arrive and got a refund of 15$ lol. Would absolutely not recommend if you are not 100000% sure about your trip.

Pedro welcomed us when we arrived at the apartment. During the stay we had the entire apartment to ourselves (the apartment has two Airbnb bedrooms). The apartment has a nice bathroom with a rain shower. The bed was super comfy as was mentioned by other reviewers here. The location is in the western part of the city centre. The part of Bolhao with its shops is about 15 minuted by foot. We particularly liked the art galleries closely, check out O! Galleria.
We had a lovely time in Porto. The apartment gave easy access and walking distance to most amenities. Had a good information booklet with recommendations in. Good communication, thank you.

Eduardo and his niece were very welcoming and nice. They were available at any moment to answer our questions or help us. The appartment is nice and just 2mins walking from the Douro River. It's located in a very beautiful and lively neighbourhood.
Nice place in the center of Porto, quick and helpful communication with the hosts. Only drawback was the noisy place in front of the building where people gathered every night and played loud music
Good location, just a few minutes walk from Sao Bento train station. Nice and clean place.

This was the best place we stayed in all of Portugal. We will happily stay here again if when come back to Porto. The pictures don't do the place justice - it's even better than it looks in the ad. And amazingly well-taken-care-of. Sonia is extremely friendly and helpful. She knows all the good places to see and eat in Porto and beyond. But honestly, she was just fun to talk to about life and anything else. Highly recommend.

Fantastic location.  Steps from the foot bridge over the river to Gaia, with beautiful sunsets.  The rooms are crisp and clean with 2 twin beds in 3 of them, which can be a king, or separated, and 2 queens or double, not sure, in the other 2 rooms.  4 nice bathrooms with good water pressure.  There is an elevator to the 3rd floor which is so nice.  It is also nice to have a balcony for fresh air.  Each room has an air spliter with AC and Heat.  The living/dinning area is spacious with a well equipped kitchen.  There is also a washer and dryer in the apartment .  I felt very safe here.  We had 8 ladies traveling together.  It was perfect for us!
The house and the location was good. The host was very kind and supportive. The showers a little tight for a big  person. But, I think that's very common in Europe.

We loved the stay here, the location and view was beautiful!  Except checking in was a pain! The cleaning lady had left the key at a cafe because of an emergency but it took us about an hour of running around to different places to find where the key was to let us into the house.

Beautiful apartment with in walking distance of all main sights, shops, restaurants and bars. The apartment is spotlessly clean, well equipped and very comfortable. The lovely  welcome gift of  Fruit, water, coffee and Port was a perfect touch. Andreia is really friendly and helpful . Can definitely recommend this apartment.
Amazing apartment with a beautiful view. The hosts were very responsive and extremely helpful and kind. I would recommend it 100%.

Very well placed and fully equiped apartment. Metro, shop and many tasty restaurants in the neighbourhood. 15 minutes walk from tourist attractions. Be carefull with the washing machine. Our clothes, after washing and drying programme (the lowest temperature available), shrinked and faded out a bit.

Marcia is the most fabulous host, so friendly and helpful... nothing to was too much. On the apartment, it completely exceeded our expectations! It has everything you need and is in a brilliant location! The terrace is fab! I’ve stayed in a number of air B&Bs (which I’ve been very lucky they’ve been excellent), however this has been the best. Look no further... this is the place for you!

I absolutely recommend Carmo's house to anyone. She is just amazing, took the time to mark the map with places I could visit as I was traveling on my own. During my stay, I felt very comfortable, had my private room with all commodities and my own bathroom. The place is very well kept, super clean and tidy and the neighborhood is secure and quite. Has a shopping center two minutes away that opens till midnight (just in case) by metro you can access to the city center in about 20 minutes. I don't think I will be able to tell in words how delighted I am that I found Carmo's place and how grateful I am to her. She even gave me goodbye present!  Thank you so much, Carmo!

100% recommend this AirBnB! It was a lovely, comfortable place to stay in for several nights with a fully functional kitchen and clean bathroom. The neighborhood was lovely and lively in the evening with the locals meeting up and having a small celebration. Everything in Porto was easily walkable from here or close to bus and train stations. We would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our night at Teodoro’s place! It was exactly as described. He was good at communicating the move in and move out instructions and offered some suggestions of things to do for our short time in town!

Carlos was a really great host, very thoughtful, the appartement was amazing, clean, nice decoration, comfortable beds. Carlos responded quickly, gave us directions on how to get to his place.  He received us very well when we arrived and gave us tips on where to go. We had a great stay!

Mariza was very lovely and let us check in early due to an early morning flight from the UK! She was very understanding when we turned up later than expected. The flat was very modern,clean and comfortable as pictured. The location was great - very easy to reach from airport and walking distance to city centre. Thanks for a great stay!

This place is a true gem! The location is near a metro stop and great for walking to main sites. This apartment is spacious and tastefully decorated and in a quiet neighborhood. Yves and Ana are great at communicating! I would definitely stay here again.
Great value. Location is close to the center so easy to get around.  The place was as described. Super clean And Rose was very responsive at all times:)
Very nice location, the flat was perfect for a baby.  The furniture was complete and the flat is very quiet, you would be surprised when you open a window.  I recommend

We were a group of 4. Bruno’s apartment is in a great location in old town area with easy walk to restaurants, local attractions, laundromat.  Apartment was clean and spacious with a fantastic balcony overlooking the town and water. Cars cannot go down the street, but it is easy access and departure with taxis next to the cathedral area.

Very beautiful and clean. Carla was incredibly nice and even had a guide for us. It was loud when the church bells went off next to us in the morning, but nothing we couldn’t manage and Carla provided ear plugs! Very beautiful place.

Great location, excellent host, extremely helpful suggestions and advice from Francisco. The apartment had everything we needed. On the fifth floor with a lift. Pleasant view from the balcony. We would thoroughly recommend to a couple.

Beautiful place, it made me feel right at home especially after traveling for a couple weeks. I didn’t want to leave! It was super clean, centrally located, private, and safe. Marta was also very responsive. I enjoyed my stay and would stay here again!

Amazing hospitality! Hugo was patient, helpful and charming. The apartment was quiet yet well positioned to explore the city. His tips on what to do we’re very helpful.  We were even allowed to store our bags with his friend at the coffee shop below the apartment. Absolutely awesome!

The flat is beautiful, very well located, super clean and very confortable. I'll definitely come back and I would recommend it to anyone. Also the host give us a map pointing out all the attractions, restaurants, and areas to visit.
Very luxurious apartment (feels like a hotel suite) in a gorgeous modern building with a great balcony and spacious private garage. Couldn’t have asked for a better base to explore Porto. Fantastic!

Pedro is a very kind host. He was attentive and made my stay very comfortable. The neighbourhood is up and coming and has lots of charme. His guesthouse is clean and I met many friendly guests. The atmosphere is great. I will return for sure! Thank you for this wonderful stay.
We really enjoyed our stay at Sofia’s apartment. It is the perfect size for a solo traveler or couple and the location is ideal for exploring Porto.

We had a wonderful stay at Miguel’s. The apartment was very comfortable, and we had everything we needed. The location was perfect with only a 5 minute walk to the Gaia riverfront and a 15-minute walk into Porto. Miguel’s communication was excellent.

The flat was perfect, well equiped, very nice and clean. We appreciated the travel cot and baby chair for our 7 months baby girl and the coffee ! The neighbourhood is really calm and there is a supermarket really close (2min by foot) Thanks a lot to the hosts !!
perfect location and the apartment have all you need . Carlos is very nice  help us with places and things to do . I love it ! the apartment is in very safe place and it was very important for me

Great location, nice place, good for families. Make sure you pay for parking if you park on the street. Unfortunately, we got a ticket; however, highly recommend this place. It was so convenient using the key punch in for check in and check out.
Tomás' place was perfectly located in walking distance from everything. The apartment had exceptional views, was nicely decorated and clean. Tomás was very responsive and flexible. Highly recommend!

Impeccable heat insulation, you will appreciate it on cold windy days. It is a renovated building just a few minutes walk from the Metro, a couple of streets away from the busy Rua de Santa Catarina, thus convenient stores, restaurants and historical sights are near by. The flat has everything you might need to stay with a family of four. Very recommended.

The loft was fantastic, really pretty and very clean.  The location is really great and central, yet the loft is very quiet so you're not affected by noise.  Paula and Rafael always respond in a timely manner and had local recommendations.  Overall stay was fab! Can't wait to be back!

The flat was spotless and clutter-free. We enjoyed every bit of our stay. The neighborhood is lively - cafes, shops, restaurants, galleries at a stone's throw. Helena and her husband were very nice and I can say it was one of hour best airbnb experiences so far. Thank you for your hospitality!!

Excellent central location, walking distance from several of the major sites. Apartment was clean with adequate space and the necessary amenities for a couple with a small child. Space was quiet and allowed for comfortable rest after long days of sightseeing. Hosts were proactive and responsive with communication, accommodating an early check-in after our overnight flight and helping us with our luggage. We would recommend to anyone and stay here again.

The apartment is in the center of the center. Good part is convenience, bad one is the disturbances on the street. We stayed during the Holy week, for some reasons people chanted and bang on something at 5am two days in a roll. Plus the area is going through construction. Get the earplugs ready!

Very nice flat, modern and clean. Great location, everything is nearby and in walking distance: popular city attractions, restaurants, a shopping mall, laundry. Staff is very friendly and helpful with any requests. We stayed for a month and there was a weekly cleaning service that made our stay easier!
Highly recommend for your stay in Porto. Greta location for sights and restaurants. 15 min walk to the river

Really enjoyed our stay at Hugo’s place! Check-in was easy and the place was clean. The door got a little stuck when we were first checking in, but Hugo was very helpful when we messaged him and we had no further issues throughout our trip. The location is also great - close to all sites and good eats. Would definitely recommend this stay!
Excellent location, close to public transport, supermarket and shops. Great hospitality and rooms. Here you feel at home!

This was our second visit to Bruno’s apartment. Excellent and prompt responses  to questions. Small but adequate apartment  with windows and an adjacent balcony to take photos of an absolutely stunning view of Porto, the Douro River, and Gaia! Steep stairs to the apartment are we’ll-lit with a sturdy handrail. So glad we came again!!

Great location and the host is good at communicating. Unfortunately we had issues with the AC on a very hot weekend and it was not resolved right away. In addition, the hot water did not last for 2 quick showers and slowed down part way through the first.

It's a nice small studio for a couple of days, and the location is good for exploring Porto. I wouldn't necessary recommend this place for more than 2 persons, because there is very little space for eating and only 1 or 2 stools. I was hoping I could have watched local tv channels for some time (and eurovision) from tv, but you can literally watch only netflix there, and the wifi connection is quite choppy.

It was a great stay in Tomas’ apartment. We were very well welcomed by Tomas who gave us many good recommendations for our stay in Porto.  I’d definitely recommend Tomas’ place for people who want to stay in Porto ! Thanks again !
Great flat in Porto close to any nice place to visit. Clean and homey ! I could only recommend 👌
