nice apartment, nice park and beach in walking distance, public transport to city center was not nearby, but Uber to come back is very affordable. nice people, take time to give ideas on where to go.

Great place in the heart of Porto. A couple streets away (3mins) from the main party streets but also far enough away that it is quiet. AC was great in the heat of Summer and room was clean and functional.
This is a perfect place for 4 people. Miguel is responsive and helpful. The location is ideal!
We had a perfect stay at Joaquims place. Would 100% recommend however be prepared that the street is quite noisy during the night so bring ear plugs or something ☺️
The room was exactly as described, the area is far from the center in a weird neighborhood (Present of prostitution). The most annoying part was the presence of cockroaches

Awesome time in Proto. Luis goes above and beyond in ensuring his guests have a truly authentic experience in the city. All of his recommendations worked out great for us and he was super friendly and responsive from initial booking all the way through our stay.  Demonstrates exactly what booking on Airbnb is all about. Thanks again Luis!
Mario was the perfect host, they were so kind and accommodating to our needs. A great location with easy access to the shops, beach and city. Thank you for hosting us in your lovely home.
Great location with good coffee and a deli across the street. Photos are accurate, clean and simple. Lovely high ceilings, would recommend for a couple or lone traveler

Really nice apartment, perfectly situated in the centre. We were friendly welcomed and the private parking in a garage is very convenient. A small disadvantage is that the second bedroom is situated right beneath the attic, so it was quite warm up there, because the air-condition from the living room couldn't cool that area down that we'll. besides that, we really enjoyed the stay.

Awesome location, super responsive host, overall great value for money! The place was perfect for a family of 4 (2+2), the kitchen was well equipped.  Highly recommended and would stay there again ourselves next time we visit Porto!

The apartment is perfectly located and I was able to walk everywhere! Only needed a drive to the airport and I highly recommend the private transfer with Carlos (Sofia recommended it and is arranging it for you!)  The apartment has everything to make you feel at home! It was great to have a washing machine. There was a clothes rack, an iron and even an iron board! Sofia is very responsive when you ask a question.

Eugenia and Luis were kind and helpful from booking to check out, and the apartment was excellent. Communication was easy and prompt leading up to our stay. Eugenia met us at check in and walked us through some informative do’s and don’ts of Porto, all of which turned out to be very helpful.  The apartment itself was truly sparkling clean, with coffee maker and pastries provided. The location made it easy to access all the sights we wanted to see in Porto. We had two days in the city and could easily have stayed for several more.  Thank you both for a wonderful stay, we hope to be back soon.
This Airbnb is amazing and easy to check into with a code so you don’t lose your keys! Both bathrooms were so clean and there are enough amenities to cook. We enjoyed it a lot!!

A neat little apartment in a great central location.  Noise from above could be a problem but there are building rules and while we were there had no problems.  Rute was welcoming and helpful, very pleasant host.

Had a lovely few days in Porto. Sónia was very friendly, had lots of recommendations for us and very responsive to messages.  The Airbnb was very clean and had everything we needed. It was well located for exploring Porto.
This place is amazing!! So many fun restaurants on the street and Susana is an amazing host.
Very nice and cozy place. Close to the subway and well connected to the city center. Everything went great!

We had a last minute change of travel plans and arrived in Porto one day before our other accommodation started... I'm so thankful we found this beautiful gem of a place (and I wish we had gotten to stay longer!).  Beatrix was extremely friendly, responsive, and accommodating. She let us check-in early, which was incredibly kind, so we didn't have to wander around for hours with our luggage. The apartment felt like a luxury hotel!  Located on a quiet street in a newly renovated building, it had everything you could need for a wonderful stay. The large private terrace was an added surprise (with a washing machine!), the bed was really comfortable, and the bathroom was spacious with a great rainfall shower.  I would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat... and you should too!

It is not everyday that you find a place when traveling that truly makes you feel at home. João’s beautiful apartment was just that for us. After a very warm welcome, we began exploring the city, enjoying being in a quiet road just a few minutes walk from everywhere. The apartment is spacious, newly renovated, fully equipped with everything you need and generally just great. We will love to come back.

Clean airbnb and safe area. Very small, but perfect for one night with 3 people. Walkable from Porto sao bento train station *kinda*. The person messaging was slightly aggressive in asking for our passport information, but otherwise a nice stay.
We had a real great time. Luis and Eugenia welcomed us very warmly and the apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable.
Fabulous holiday destination, great local knowledge on arrival, thank you Grace, quiet, comfortable, well appointed accommodation, superb communication with hosts, thank you
Miguel's house is in a great location, within walking distance of the Moru Park, the Luis Bridge, and the Porto wine district. We made many good memories of Porto here. Thank you.

Alice’s place is a great space for a visit to Porto. While it’s a little far from the main squares and the Ribiero district, it is well worth the walk! When I return to Porto I would surely book this place again.

Very well located, very clean and had all amenities for a short trip. Just unfortunate there was a lot of noise from construction around, but it seems half of Porto is being renovated. Thanks again for a seamless stay.
A lovely apartment, great for two people. A really comfortable double bed! Kitchen fully equipped. Lurdes was good about our late arrival and changed details.

Pros - place looked just like the pictures. Very clean  and modern space  - had all the basics and essentials needed for our stay  - great location  - host was very responsive and helpful Cons - I wouldn't even consider this a con as the issue was dealt with very quickly. The power went out in the morning and the host got someone in the house immediately dealing with the issue.  loved our stay here and would highly recommend!

We enjoyed staying in this villa. The villa was very clean. The location was perfect and close to restaurants and shops. The owners are so easy to work with. They had all the local information for us..  There are some stairs that you need to climb, but it is worth the climb! We really had a great time! Hope to stay in this charming villa again!   - Sarah

Perfect for us for our long weekend in Porto. Location was great for exploring everywhere on foot and the apartment was very clean and well equipped. The balcony was great for having a drink with a view in the mornings/evenings. Maggie was an excellent host, very knowledgeable about the local area and gave great recommendations on where to visit/eat. Would love to stay again.
Our host told us everything wa had to know about Porto and helped us plan our weekend. Very nice introduction to porto.
I recommend this airbnb to everyone who wants to see the beautiful city Porto. Its a really nice apartment for two persons. Its clean and has everything you need for a citytrip!

One of my favorite airbnbs of all time! Apartment exceeded my expectations. Clean, spacious, fitted with all necessities plus more. The location was perfect and walkable to all monuments and historical buildings. Pedro was very friendly and provided us a list of his personal recommendations for restaurants and bars.
